excerpt: Thirty-two founders across 22 new-age tech companies earned a combined ₹81.08 Cr in fixed remuneration in FY26, up 3.4% from…
paragraph1: Thirty-two founders across 22 new-age tech companies earned a combined ₹81.08 Cr in fixed remuneration in FY26, up 3.4% from ₹78.43 Cr in FY25. These figures exclude separately disclosed bonuses, incentives, perquisites, and stock-linked compensation. Average remuneration per founder rose to ₹2.53 Cr from ₹2.45 Cr. Of the 32 founders tracked, 22 received increases, five saw reductions, and five reported unchanged remuneration. IndiaMART cofounder Dinesh Agarwal topped the list with ₹5.9 Cr in fixed remuneration, up from ₹5.5 Cr in FY25. Lenskart cofounder Peyush Bansal followed at ₹5.7 Cr, despite a 1.7% decline from ₹5.8 Cr. Meesho cofounders Vidit Aatrey and Sanjeev Kumar came next at ₹4.8 Cr each, ahead of Ola Electric founder Bhavish Aggarwal at ₹4.5 Cr, IndiaMART cofounder Brijesh Agarwal at ₹4.3 Cr, and Paytm founder Vijay Shekhar Sharma at ₹4 Cr. At the lower end, EaseMyTrip founder Nishant Pitti drew ₹24 Lakh, followed by Purple Style Labs founder Abhishek Agarwal at ₹72 Lakh, and Nykaa founder Falguni Nayar at ₹74 Lakh. Who Got A Raise? Honasa Consumer cofounder Ghazal Alagh recorded the highest percentage increase, with her fixed remuneration rising 60% to ₹2.4 Cr from ₹1.5 Cr. Zaggle cofounder Avinash Ramesh Godkhindi followed with a 41.9% rise to ₹1.1 Cr from ₹77.5 Lakh. Delhivery cofounder Sahil Barua’s fixed pay increased 21.4% to ₹3.4 Cr from ₹2.8 Cr. Pitti recorded the steepest percentage decline, with his remuneration falling 75% to ₹24 Lakh from ₹96 Lakh. Aggarwal followed with a 34.8% reduction to ₹4.5 Cr from ₹6.9 Cr. Nykaa founder Falguni Nayar’s remuneration fell 14% to ₹74 Lakh from ₹86 Lakh, while Swiggy cofounder Sriharsha Majety’s declined 12.
paragraph2: 5% to ₹1.4 Cr from ₹1.6 Cr. Beyond The Annual Salary Annual salaries tell only part of the story. Peyush Bansal received ₹12 Cr in bonuses and performance incentives, more than twice his fixed remuneration, along with perquisites and retirement benefits. Fellow Lenskart cofounder Neha Bansal received ₹6 Cr in bonuses and performance incentives, in addition to ₹2.7 Cr in fixed pay. MobiKwik cofounders Bipin Preet Singh and Upasana Taku received ₹2.9 Cr each in bonuses and incentives, taking their individual fixed pay and bonuses to ₹6.4 Cr. Honasa Consumer cofounder Varun Alagh received ₹2.4 Cr in performance incentives, equal to his fixed remuneration. ixigo cofounder Aloke Bajpai received ₹30.2 Lakh in variable pay on top of ₹1.4 Cr in fixed remuneration. Stock-linked compensation added another dimension. Majety’s disclosed ESOP gains stood at ₹549.3 Cr, while Delhivery cofounder Kapil Bharati recorded ₹6.9 Cr in ESOP gains. Separately, the disclosed cost of stock options granted to FirstCry founder Supam Maheshwari stood at ₹31.7 Cr. He also received ₹2.1 Cr in perquisites and ₹84 Lakh in performance incentives, alongside ₹1.4 Cr in fixed remuneration. The accrued ESOP expense associated with Bajpai stood at ₹15.7 Cr. ESOP gains and stock-option costs are different measures and should not be treated as equivalent to cash salaries. The accounting expense associated with stock options does not necessarily represent cash received by a founder during the year. Inc42 has tracked founders’ remuneration since FY23, covering the startup ecosystem’s shift from the funding boom to the funding winter and, more recently, towards profitability and IPOs. Building on the FY25 edition, the FY26 tracker examines changes in remuneration, other compensation components, and the financial performance of the companies these founders lead. Editor’s Note: This is a running tracker and will be updated periodically. Companies are listed alphabetically in the table. The aggregate and average remuneration figures above cover fixed pay only. Dinesh Agarwal’s fixed remuneration rose 7.3% to ₹5.9 Cr from ₹5.5 Cr in FY25, while Brijesh Agarwal’s increased 7.5% to ₹4.3 Cr from ₹4 Cr. They also received ₹2.4 Cr and ₹1.8 Cr, respectively, in performance incentives. IndiaMART’s net profit fell 13.8% to ₹474.7 Cr in FY26 from ₹550.7 Cr in FY25. Operating revenue increased 13% to ₹1,569 Cr. Peyush Bansal | Lenskart The Lenskart cofounder and CEO earned ₹5.7 Cr in fixed remuneration in FY26. In addition to his fixed pay, Bansal also received ₹12 Cr in bonus and performance incentives, along with ₹24.04 Lakh in perquisites and ₹7.5 Lakh in retirals. Lenskart’s net profit rose 69% YoY to ₹500.9 Cr in FY26, while operating revenue increased 33% YoY to ₹8,814 Cr. Its profit growth was aided by operating leverage, premiumisation, and growth in international markets.
bangla_paragraph1: ২২ টি নতুন যুগের প্রযুক্তি সংস্থার ২২ জন প্রতিষ্ঠাতা ২৬ অর্থবছরে স্থির পারিশ্রমিক হিসাবে ৮১.০৮ কোটি টাকা আয় করেছেন, যা ২৬ আর্থিক বছরে ৭৮.৪৩ কোটি টাকা থেকে ৩.৪% বৃদ্ধি পেয়েছে। এই পরিসংখ্যানগুলি পৃথকভাবে প্রকাশিত বোনাস, উদ্দীপনা, পার্সোসিটি এবং স্টক-লিঙ্ক ক্ষতিপূরণকে বাদ দেয়। প্রতি প্রতিষ্ঠাতার গড় পারিশ্রাম ২.৪৫ কোটি টাকা থেকেই ২.৫৩ কোটি টাকায় বেড়েছে। ট্র্যাক করা ৩২ জন প্রতিষ্ঠাতাকে ২২ জন বৃদ্ধি পেয়েছেন, পাঁচজন হ্রাস পেয়েছেন এবং পাঁচজন অপরিবর্তিত পারিশ্ৰমিক পেয়েছেন। ইন্ডিয়ামার্ট সহ-প্রতিষ্ঠাতা দীনেশ আগরফিল ৫.৯ কোটি টাকার সাথে তালিকার শীর্ষে রয়েছেন।
bangla_paragraph2: ৫% থেকে ১.৬ কোটি টাকা পর্যন্ত। বার্ষিক বেতন ছাড়িয়ে বার্ষିକ বেতনগুলি গল্পের কেবলমাত্র একটি অংশ বলে। পিয়ুশ বানসাল বনাস এবং পারফরম্যান্স উত্সাহে ১২ কোটি টাকা পেয়েছিলেন, যা তার স্থির পারিশ্রমিকের দ্বিগুণেরও বেশি, পারকিসিট এবং অবসর সুবিধা সহ। সহকর্মী লেনসকার্ট সহ-প্রতিষ্ঠাতা নেহা বানসল বনাসে এবং পারফিউম ইনসেনটিভগুলিতে ₹ 6 কোটি টাকা পেয়েছেন, স্থির বেতনের পাশাপাশি ₹ 2.7 কোটি টাকা। মোবিউইক সহ-প্ৰতিষ্ঠাতারা বিপিন প্রীত সিং এবং উপসনা টাকু বনাসের এবং উত্সহায়নগুলিতে 2.9 কোটি টাকা প্রত্যেকে পেয়েছেন।

title: 1Password data breach: How hackers accessed its systems, what data was exposed and are passwords safe?
title_bn: ১পাসওয়ার্ড ডেটা লঙ্ঘনঃ হ্যাকাররা কিভাবে এর সিস্টেমগুলিতে প্রবেশ করেছে, কোন তথ্য প্রকাশিত হয়েছে এবং পাসওয়ার্ডগুলি নিরাপদ?
author: TechPulse
excerpt: 1Password disclosed a security breach in which hackers accessed backend systems, exposing customer names, email addresses and account metadata. The company said stored passwords, Secret Keys and encrypted vaults remain safe, with no evidence of accou
paragraph1: 1Password disclosed a security breach in which hackers accessed backend systems, exposing customer names, email addresses and account metadata. The company said stored passwords, Secret Keys and encrypted vaults remain safe, with no evidence of account takeovers.1Password security breach: How hackers accessed its systems, what data was exposed and are passwords safe?(Image generated using AI. )Password management platform 1Password has disclosed a security incident in which an attacker gained access to some of its backend systems and downloaded customer account information.The company said the breach affected a subset of users, exposing details such as names, email addresses and certain non-sensitive account metadata.However, 1Password stressed that customer vaults, stored passwords, secret keys and other encrypted information were not accessed or compromised.In a security update published on November 25, the company said it began investigating suspicious activity on November 19 after detecting signs that an attacker had gained access to an employee's corporate GitHub account.The attacker allegedly used the compromised account to access 1Password's source code repositories and introduce malicious code into backend services.These services subsequently downloaded administrative information associated with some customer accounts.
paragraph2: What information was exposed in the 1Password breach?According to the company, the attacker copied account records belonging to a subset of users.The information included customer names, email addresses, account and user identifiers, account creation dates and last sign-in times.The exposed information also included public keys, Secure Remote Password (SRP) protocol parameters, and certain tokens contained in emailed links used for invitations, account provisioning and account recovery.1Password clarified that the public keys are public by design and that the exposed SRP parameters cannot be used to access customer accounts.The attacker also copied source code from private repositories and gained access to the company's continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) system, which contains infrastructure-related credentials.The company said it had rotated credentials that may have been exposed and found no evidence of customer account takeovers or misuse of exposed provisioning tokens.Were passwords and stored vaults compromised?1Password said its customers' vault contents, stored items and the encryption keys protecting them remained secure throughout the incident.The company explained that it does not have access to customers' account passwords or Secret Keys, which are used to protect their encrypted vaults.
paragraph3: Consequently, gaining access to its backend systems does not automatically give an attacker access to the information stored inside customer vaults.The company also said its account recovery keys, applications and browser extensions were not affected.What has 1Password done after the security incident?Following the discovery, 1Password said that it disabled the affected GitHub account, revoked the compromised access token and removed access created by the attacker.The platform said that it also rotated or revoked potentially exposed internal credentials, strengthened security controls across its GitHub and CI/CD systems, and introduced additional threat detection measures.As a precaution, the company increased the length of codes used in invitation and account recovery emails from six numeric digits to 10 alphanumeric characters, making them significantly harder to guess.1Password also brought in independent cybersecurity experts to review its containment and remediation measures.What should 1Password users do?The company said customers do not need to make changes to their accounts or update their passwords following the incident.However, it advised users to remain alert to phishing attempts, particularly unexpected emails, messages or calls involving account invitations and recovery requests.
paragraph4:
1Password cautioned customers against sharing their account passwords or Secret Keys, adding that it would never ask users to disclose these credentials.The company said its applications and services continue to operate normally and pledged to update its security disclosure if further findings emerge.About the AuthorBhanu PratapBhanu Pratap is a journalist who reports and writes on foreign affairs, India’s foreign policy, geopolitics and strategic affairs. He closely follows diplomatic developments in New Delhi and has a keen interest in defence and national security.

Bhanu also focuses on in-depth, interview-based reports and regularly speaking with experts and policymakers to bring perspectives and context to major developments around the world.

He is also interested in stories with strong humanitarian angles.

One such report examined the cases of Indian nationals who were allegedly recruited and forced into Russia’s war against Ukraine. While reporting the story, Bhanu spoke to the families of those affected and documented their experiences. The report was later taken into account by the United Nations in its findings on human rights violations linked to the war in Ukraine.

For Bhanu, the zeal to produce meaningful and impactful journalism remains at the heart of his work.
paragraph5:
He has previously worked with Firstpost, NDTV, Newslaundry and Republic.

Bhanu studied at the Delhi School of Journalism, University of Delhi. He initially chose science with plans to pursue engineering, influenced by conventional expectations, but fate had other plans and eventually led him to journalism.

Beyond the newsroom, Bhanu enjoys exploring culture and history and often spends his days off on heritage walks. He is also passionate about travelling, biking and listening to folk music.

For tips, reviews and suggestions, you can reach him at bhanu.pratap@htdigital.in.
bangla_paragraph1: ১পাসওয়ার্ড একটি নিরাপত্তা লঙ্ঘন প্রকাশ করেছে যাতে হ্যাকাররা ব্যাকএন্ড সিস্টেমগুলিতে অ্যাক্সেস করেছে, গ্রাহকের নাম, ইমেল ঠিকানা এবং অ্যাকাউন্ট মেটাডেটা প্রকাশ করেছে। সংস্থাটি বলেছে যে সংরক্ষিত পাসওয়ার্ড, সিক্রেট কী এবং এনক্রিপ্ট করা ভল্টগুলি অ্যাকাউট অধিগ্রহণের কোনও প্রমাণ ছাড়াই নিরাপদ রয়েছে। ১প্যাসওয়ার্ড সুরক্ষা লঙ্ଘনঃ হ্যাকার্স কীভাবে তার সিস্টেমে অ্যাকসেস করেছে এবং কী ডেটা প্রকাশিত হয়েছিল এবং পাসওয়র্ডগুলি নিরাপদ?
bangla_paragraph2: 1Password লঙ্ঘনে কোন তথ্য উন্মুক্ত করা হয়েছিল?কোম্পানির মতে, আক্রমণকারী ব্যবহারকারীদের একটি উপসেটের অন্তর্গত অ্যাকাউন্ট রেকর্ডগুলি অনুলিপি করেছিল। তথ্যগুলির মধ্যে গ্রাহকের নাম, ইমেল ঠিকানা, অ্যাকাઉন্ট এবং ব্যবহারকারীর সনাক্তকারী, অ্যাকউন্ট তৈরির তারিখ এবং শেষ লগ-ইন সময় অন্তর্ভুক্ত ছিল। উন্মোচনকৃত তথ্যগুলির অন্তর্ভুক্ত ছিল পাবলিক কী, সুরক্ষিত রিমোট পাসওয়ার্ড (এসআরপি) প্রোটোকল পরামিতি এবং আমন্ত্রণ, অ্যাকিউন্ট সরবরাহ এবং অ্যাকাଉন্ট পুনরুদ্ধারের জন্য ব্যবহৃত ইমেল লিঙ্কগুলিতে থাকা নির্দিষ্ট টোকেনগুলি।1Password
bangla_paragraph3: ফলস্বরূপ, এর ব্যাকএন্ড সিস্টেমে অ্যাক্সেস অর্জন করা স্বয়ংক্রিয়ভাবে আক্রমণকারীকে গ্রাহকের ভল্টের ভিতরে সংরক্ষিত তথ্য অ্যাকসেস দেয় না। সংস্থাটি আরও বলেছে যে এর অ্যাকাউন্ট পুনরুদ্ধার কী, অ্যাপ্লিকেশন এবং ব্রাউজার এক্সটেনশনগুলি প্রভাবিত হয়নি। 1 পাসওয়ার্ড সুরক্ষা ঘটনার পরে কী করেছে?আবিষ্কারের পরে, 1 পাসওর্ড বলেছে এটি আক্রান্ত গিটহাব অ্যাকাઉন্টটি অক্ষম করেছে, আপোষিত অ্যাক্স টোকেন প্রত্যাহার করেছে এবং আক্রমণকারীর দ্বারা তৈরি অ্যাকসেস সরিয়ে দিয়েছে। প্ল্যাটফর্মটি বলেছে
bangla_paragraph4: ১পাসওয়ার্ড গ্রাহকদের তাদের অ্যাকাউন্টের পাসওয়ার্ড বা সিক্রেট কী শেয়ার না করার জন্য সতর্ক করে বলেছে যে তারা কখনই ব্যবহারকারীদের এই শংসাপত্রগুলি প্রকাশ করতে বলবে না। সংস্থাটি বলেছে তার অ্যাপ্লিকেশন এবং পরিষেবাগুলি স্বাভাবিকভাবে কাজ চালিয়ে যাচ্ছে এবং আরও অনুসন্ধান হলে তার সুরক্ষা প্রকাশ আপডেট করার প্রতিশ্রুতি দিয়েছে। লেখক সম্পর্কেভানু প্রতাপভানুপ্রতাপ একজন সাংবাদিক যিনি বিদেশ বিষয়, ভারতের বিদেশ নীতি, ভূ-রাজনীতি এবং কৌশলগত বিষয়গুলি সম্পর্কে রিপোর্ট করেন এবং লিখেছেন। তিনি কূটনৈতিক উন্নয়নগুলি ঘনিষ্ঠভাবে অনুসরণ করেন।
bangla_paragraph5: ভানু প্রথমবারের মতো নিউজ পোস্টে, এনডিটিভিতে, নিউজ লন্ড্রি এবং রিপাবলিকের সাথে কাজ করেছেন। ভানু দিল্লি বিশ্ববিদ্যালয়ের দিল্লি স্কুল অফ জার্নালিজম থেকে পড়াশোনা করেছিলেন। তিনি প্রাথমিকভাবে প্রকৌশল অনুসরণ করার পরিকল্পনা নিয়ে বিজ্ঞান বেছে নিয়েছিলেন, প্রচলিত প্রত্যাশার দ্বারা প্রভাবিত হয়েছিলেন, তবে ভাগ্যের অন্য পরিকল্পনা ছিল এবং শেষ পর্যন্ত তাকে সাংবাদিকতায় নিয়ে এসেছিলেন। নিউজরুমের বাইরে ভানু সংস্কৃতি এবং ইতিহাস অন্বেষণ করতে পছন্দ করেন এবং প্রায়শই তার দিনগুলি heritageতিহ্য পদচারণা করে ব্যয় করেন। তিনি ভ্রমণ, বাইক চালানো এবং লিজ সম্পর্কেও উত্সাহী।

title: Vivo X500 series launched in India with 200MP ZEISS camera, 7,800mAh battery: Check price and specifications
title_bn: ভারতে ২০০ মেগাপিক্সেলের জেস ক্যামেরা, ৭৮০০ এমএএইচ ব্যাটারি সহ ভিভো এক্স৫০০ সিরিজ লঞ্চ: দাম ও স্পেসিফিকেশন দেখুন
author: TechPulse
excerpt: Vivo has launched the X500, X500 Pro and X500 Pro Max in India, featuring up to a 200-megapixel ZEISS camera, a Dimensity 9600 Pro chipset and batteries of up to 7,800mAh. Prices start at ₹1,19,999, with sales beginning on December 3, alongside the l
paragraph1: Vivo has launched the X500, X500 Pro and X500 Pro Max in India, featuring up to a 200-megapixel ZEISS camera, a Dimensity 9600 Pro chipset and batteries of up to 7,800mAh. Prices start at ₹1,19,999, with sales beginning on December 3, alongside the launch of the Vivo Watch GT 2 smartwatch.Vivo has launched the X500, X500 Pro and X500 Pro Max in India.Vivo has launched its X500 flagship smartphone series in India on Thursday, November 26, introducing three models: the Vivo X500, X500 Pro and X500 Pro Max. The new lineup emphasises camera performance, top-tier screens and large batteries. The Vivo X500 Pro Max leads the series with a 200 MP periscope telephoto camera developed in partnership with ZEISS. The company has also launched the Vivo Watch GT 2 smartwatch in India with the smartphones.The new smartphones replace the Vivo X300 range and are powered by MediaTek's newest Dimensity chips. They also run Android 17 with OriginOS 7, and have enhanced camera and fast-charging support. With prices starting at ₹119,999, Vivo is targeting the premium flagship segment. Here is a look at their specifications, prices and availability.Vivo X500 series: Display and designThe Vivo X500 series has a distinctive circular camera layout, aluminium frames and glass rear panels.
paragraph2: The three handsets have all been rated as dust- and water-resistant (IP69). The X500 Pro Max features a 6.85-inch LTPO 2K AMOLED panel with a 144 Hz refresh rate and can achieve up to 4,500 nits of peak brightness.The X500 Pro has a smaller 6.36-inch, 1.5K LTPO AMOLED display, whereas the standard X500 comes with a 6.59-inch, 144Hz, 1.5K AMOLED screen.Vivo X500 series: Camera specifications The biggest standout of the new lineup is the camera performance. Vivo has revealed that the X500 Pro Max will sport a 3.5x optical zoom camera with a 200 MP Samsung HP0 periscope telephoto camera on top of a primary 50 MP Sony LYTIA sensor and a Samsung 50 MP ultrawide camera. It also gets a 50 MP front camera.
paragraph3: The X500 Pro has the same primary and ultrawide sensors but has a 64 MP periscope telephoto camera. The standard X500 features a 50 MP Sony primary sensor, a 64 MP telephoto camera and a 50 MP ultrawide sensor.All three models come with ZEISS optics and T-star lens coating. Supported features of the Pro models include log video recording and custom LUTs. Vivo has kept compatibility with its X300-series teleconverter accessories. Vivo X500 series: Processor and battery The X500 Pro and Pro Max are powered by the 2nm MediaTek Dimensity 9600 Pro chipset, paired with 12GB RAM and up to 512GB storage. The Dimensity 9600M is the processor used in the standard X500.The Pro Max has a battery capacity of 7,800 mAh, the X500 has a battery of 7,500 mAh, and the X500 Pro has a 6,510 mAh battery. All three offer 90W wired and 40W wireless charging. Vivo will guarantee 5 years of Android updates and 7 years of security patches. Vivo Watch GT 2: Features and battery In addition to the smartphones, Vivo has also introduced the Watch GT 2 in India, priced at ₹14,999. It has a 2.
paragraph4: 07-inch AMOLED display that refreshes the screen at 60 Hz and can be as bright as 2,400 nits.The smartwatch is equipped with BlueOS 3.0 and has built-in heart rate, blood oxygen, stress and sleep monitors. It also features over 100 sports modes, GPS, NFC, and Bluetooth calling. Vivo promises up to 25 days of battery life, which amounts to 14 days of usage and 12 days with the display always on.Vivo X500 series, Watch GT 2 prices in India and availabilityVivo X500 is priced at ₹119,999 for its variant with 12GB RAM and 256GB storage. The X500 Pro costs ₹149,999, while the X500 Pro Max starts at ₹164,999. Its 512GB variant costs ₹179,999.The Pro Max Photographer Kit, which comes with the teleconverter accessories, is priced at ₹229,999. The two available teleconverter extenders are priced at ₹15,999 and ₹27,999, respectively, for 200 mm and 400 mm, respectively.According to Vivo, pre-bookings for the X500 series and Watch GT 2 begin on November 26, with open sales starting on December 3, 2026. Buyers can avail up to 10% instant cashback or exchange bonuses on the smartphones.
paragraph5: The smartwatch is also available with a ₹1,500 bundle discount.About the AuthorPragya Singha RoyPragya is a Technology reporter with over four years of experience in digital media and content writing. She holds a Master’s degree in Journalism and has covered a wide range of stories spanning space, smartphones, gadgets, artificial intelligence, emerging technologies and the ways technology is transforming everyday life. She focuses on breaking down complex technology and science developments into clear, engaging, and reader-friendly stories, with a keen interest in emerging trends and their real-world impact. Before joining her current newsroom, Pragya worked with News9Live, where she covered the technology beat extensively, reporting on smartphones, consumer technology, AI, space and science, while also contributing to video and visual content. Her experience includes breaking news, explainers, SEO-driven stories, product coverage, interviews, unboxing videos and live event reporting. She has also covered major technology and AI events, giving her experience in both newsroom and on-ground reporting. Beyond journalism, Pragya is an avid gamer and a passionate reader of fiction. She enjoys exploring immersive worlds through games and books, with a particular interest in stories that offer new perspectives, ideas, and experiences.

bangla_paragraph2: তিনটি হ্যান্ডসেটকে ধুলো এবং জল প্রতিরোধী (আইপি 69) হিসাবে রেট দেওয়া হয়েছে। এক্স৫০০ প্রো ম্যাক্সের একটি ৬.৮৫ ইঞ্চি এলটিপিও ২ কে অ্যামোলেড প্যানেল রয়েছে যার রিফ্রেশ রেট ১৪৪ হার্জ এবং এটি সর্বোচ্চ উজ্জ্বলতার ৪৫০০ নিট পর্যন্ত অর্জন করতে পারে। এক্স ৫০০ প্রো এর একটি ছোট ৬.৩৬ ইঞ্চির, ১.৫ কে এলটিপো অ্যামোলড ডিসপ্লে রয়েছে, যেখানে স্ট্যান্ডার্ড এক্স৫০০০ এর সাথে ৬.৫৯ ইঞ্চী, ১৪৪ এইচজি, ১.5 কে অামোলেডে স্ক্রিন রয়েছে। ভিভো এক্স৫০ সিরিজঃ ক্যামেরা স্পেসিফিকেশন নতুন লাইনআপের সবচেয়ে বড় স্ট্যান্ডআউট হ'ল ক্যামেরা পারফরম্যান্স। ভিভিও প্রকাশ করেছে যে এক্স৫১ প্রো মাক্স
bangla_paragraph3: X500 প্রো একই প্রাথমিক এবং অতি-বৃহত্তর সেন্সর রয়েছে তবে একটি 64 এমপি পেরিস্কোপ টেলিফোটো ক্যামেরা রয়েছে। স্ট্যান্ডার্ড X500 এর একটি 50 এমপি সনি প্রাথমিক সেন্সরের বৈশিষ্ট্য রয়েছে, একটি 64 MP টেলিফটো ক্যামেরার এবং একটি 50 MP অতি-বিস্তৃত সেন্সোর। তিনটি মডেলই জেআইএসএস অপটিক্স এবং টি-স্টার লেন্স লেপ সহ আসে। প্রো মডেলগুলির সমর্থিত বৈশিষ্ট্যগুলির মধ্যে লগ ভিডিও রেকর্ডিং এবং কাস্টম LUT অন্তর্ভুক্ত রয়েছে। ভিভো তার এক্স 300 সিরিজের টেলিকনভার্টার আনুষাঙ্গিকগুলির সাথে সামঞ্জস্য বজায় রেখেছে। ভিভিও এক্স 500 সিরিজঃ প্রসেসর এবং ব্যাটারি এক্স 500 প্রো এবং প্রো ম্যাক্স ar
bangla_paragraph4: 07-ইঞ্চি অ্যামোলেড ডিসপ্লে যা 60 হার্জে স্ক্রিনটি রিফ্রেশ করে এবং 2,400 নিট পর্যন্ত উজ্জ্বল হতে পারে। স্মার্টওয়াচটি ব্লুওএস 3.0 দিয়ে সজ্জিত এবং এর অন্তর্নির্মিত হার্ট রেট, রক্ত অক্সিজেন, স্ট্রেস এবং ঘুম মনিটর রয়েছে। এটিতে 100 টিরও বেশি স্পোর্টস মোড, জিপিএস, এনএফসি এবং ব্লুটুথ কলিং রয়েছে। ভিভো 25 দিনের ব্যাটারি লাইফের প্রতিশ্রুতি দেয়, যা 14 দিনের ব্যবহারের পরিমাণ এবং 12 দিনের সাথে প্রদর্শনটি সর্বদা চালু থাকে। ভিভিও এক্স 500 সিরিজ, ওয়াচ জিটি 2 দাম ভারতে এবং প্রাপ্যতাভিভিভো এক্স 500 এর দাম ₹ 119,999 এর জন্য এর ভ্যালিডেশন

title: Want to turn Apple's iPhone Duo into a mini laptop? New keyboard case adds trackpad and MagSafe support
title_bn: অ্যাপলের আইফোন ডুওকে মিনি ল্যাপটপে পরিণত করতে চান? নতুন কীবোর্ড কেস ট্র্যাকপ্যাড এবং ম্যাগসেফ সাপোর্ট যোগ করে
author: TechPulse
excerpt: Nøord has unveiled a $249 keyboard case for Apple's iPhone Duo, featuring a built-in trackpad, five-row keyboard and MagSafe connectivity to create a mini laptop-like setup. Available in Black, White and Titanium, the accessory is expected to start s
paragraph1: Nøord has unveiled a $249 keyboard case for Apple's iPhone Duo, featuring a built-in trackpad, five-row keyboard and MagSafe connectivity to create a mini laptop-like setup. Available in Black, White and Titanium, the accessory is expected to start shipping in January 2027.Nøord has unveiled a $249 keyboard case for Apple's iPhone Duo.A start-up named Nøord has introduced a new keyboard case designed specifically for Apple's upcoming foldable iPhone, the iPhone Duo. The accessory will turn the foldable smartphone into a compact, laptop-like gadget with a built-in trackpad, a five-row keyboard, and MagSafe connectivity. The Nøord Keyboard case will cost $249 (around ₹22,000) and will be available for purchase starting in January 2027.The new accessory is inspired by Apple's Magic keyboard cases for the iPad Air and iPad Pro.
paragraph2: It features MagSafe magnetic attachment, so the iPhone Duo attaches to the keyboard magnetically without being permanently fastened, making the phone appear to hover above it. Nøord has also announced three colour options: Black, White and Titanium. The company shared details of the accessory through its product announcement.Nøord Keyboard case brings iPad-style design to iPhone DuoThe Nøord Keyboard case follows a design similar to Apple's Magic Keyboard. It is magnetic, so users can place the iPhone Duo on top of the keyboard and make a small laptop. This also allows attaching the phone without removing the current compatible case.Nøord is also releasing a separate jacket case for the smartphone and keyboard, bringing them closer in style.
paragraph3: The keyboard has five lines of keys, which are based on Apple's US keyboard layout. It also has an integrated trackpad, which might be beneficial for desktop-like operation.Nøord Keyboard case price and availabilityNøord has priced its new keyboard case at $249, with black, white and titanium finishes available. According to the company's announcement, shipments are expected to start in January 2027.The accessory can be powered by a USB Type-C charger located on its left side. However, prospective buyers should consider the company's limited track record before placing an order. Nøord is a start-up company that has yet to prove its delivery time and the quality of its products.
paragraph4: The keyboard case is a neat idea to enhance the productivity of Apple's foldable iPhone. However, its practical value will depend on the iPhone Duo's software support for external keyboards, trackpads and multitasking.About the AuthorPragya Singha RoyPragya is a Technology reporter with over four years of experience in digital media and content writing. She holds a Master’s degree in Journalism and has covered a wide range of stories spanning space, smartphones, gadgets, artificial intelligence, emerging technologies and the ways technology is transforming everyday life. She focuses on breaking down complex technology and science developments into clear, engaging, and reader-friendly stories, with a keen interest in emerging trends and their real-world impact. Before joining her current newsroom, Pragya worked with News9Live, where she covered the technology beat extensively, reporting on smartphones, consumer technology, AI, space and science, while also contributing to video and visual content. Her experience includes breaking news, explainers, SEO-driven stories, product coverage, interviews, unboxing videos and live event reporting.
paragraph5: She has also covered major technology and AI events, giving her experience in both newsroom and on-ground reporting. Beyond journalism, Pragya is an avid gamer and a passionate reader of fiction. She enjoys exploring immersive worlds through games and books, with a particular interest in stories that offer new perspectives, ideas, and experiences.
bangla_paragraph1: নর্ড অ্যাপলের আইফোন ডুওর জন্য একটি 249 ডলারের কীবোর্ড কেস উন্মোচন করেছে, এতে একটি অন্তর্নির্মিত ট্র্যাকপ্যাড, পাঁচ-সারি কীবোর্ড এবং মিনি ল্যাপটপের মতো সেটআপ তৈরির জন্য ম্যাগসেফ সংযোগ রয়েছে। কালো, সাদা এবং টাইটানিয়ামে উপলব্ধ, আনুষাঙ্গিকটি জানুয়ারী ২০২৭ সালে শিপিং শুরু করার আশা করা হচ্ছে। নর্ড অ্যাপলের আইফোনে ডুয়ের জন্য একটি ২৪৯ ডলারের কিবোর্ড কেস প্রকাশ করেছে। নোর্ড নামে একটি স্টার্টআপ অ্যাপলের আসন্ন ভাঁজযোগ্য আইফোন, আইফোন ডিউয়ের জন্য বিশেষভাবে ডিজাইন করা একটি নতুন কীবোয়ার কেস চালু করেছে। আনুষঙ্গিক f চালু করবে।
bangla_paragraph2: এটিতে ম্যাগসেফ চৌম্বকীয় সংযুক্তি রয়েছে, তাই আইফোন ডুও স্থায়ীভাবে সংযুক্ত না হয়ে কীবোর্ডের সাথে চৌম্বকে সংযুক্ত হয়, ফোনটি এর উপরে ঝুলে থাকা বলে মনে হয়। নর্ড এছাড়াও কালো, সাদা এবং টাইটানিয়াম তিনটি রঙের বিকল্প ঘোষণা করেছে। সংস্থাটি তার পণ্য ঘোষণার মাধ্যমে আনুষাঙ্গিকের বিবরণ ভাগ করেছে। নোর্ড কীবোর্ড কেস আইফোন দোতে আইপ্যাড-শৈলী নকশা নিয়ে আসে। নর্ড কীबोর্ড কেস অ্যাপলের ম্যাজিক কীবোয়ারের অনুরূপ নকশা অনুসরণ করে। এটি চৌম্বকের, তাই ব্যবহারকারীরা
bangla_paragraph3: কীবোর্ডটিতে পাঁচটি কী লাইন রয়েছে, যা অ্যাপলের মার্কিন কীবোর্ডের বিন্যাসের উপর ভিত্তি করে। এটিতে একটি ইন্টিগ্রেটেড ট্র্যাকপ্যাডও রয়েছে, এটি ডেস্কটপের মতো অপারেশনের জন্য উপকারী হতে পারে। নর্ড কীবোার্ড কেসের দাম এবং উপলভ্যতানর্ড তার নতুন কীবোয়ারের কেসের মূল্য 249 ডলার, কালো, সাদা এবং টাইটানিয়াম সমাপ্তি সহ উপলব্ধ। সংস্থার ঘোষণা অনুযায়ী, শিপমেন্টগুলি জানুয়ারী 2027 সালে শুরু হবে বলে আশা করা হচ্ছে। আনুষাঙ্গিকটি তার বাম দিকে অবস্থিত ইউএসবি টাইপ-সি চার্জার দ্বারা চালিত হতে পারে । তবে, ভবিষ্যতে, এটির জন্য একটি নতুন কী বোর্ডের প্রয়োজন হবে।
bangla_paragraph4: কীবোর্ড কেসটি অ্যাপলের ভাঁজযোগ্য আইফোনের উত্পাদনশীলতা বাড়ানোর জন্য একটি ঝরঝরে ধারণা। তবে এর ব্যবহারিক মূল্য আইফোন ডুওর বাহ্যিক কীবোার্ড, ট্র্যাকপ্যাড এবং মাল্টিটাস্কিংয়ের সফ্টওয়্যার সমর্থনের উপর নির্ভর করবে। লেখক সম্পর্কেপ্রজ্ঞ সিংহ রায়প্রজ্ঞ ডিজিটাল মিডিয়া এবং সামগ্রী লেখার চার বছরেরও বেশি অভিজ্ঞতার সাথে প্রযুক্তি প্রতিবেদক। তিনি সাংবাদিকতায় স্নাতকোত্তর ডিগ্রি অর্জন করেছেন এবং মহাকাশ, স্মার্টফোন, গ্যাজেট, কৃত্রিম বুদ্ধিমত্তা,
bangla_paragraph5: প্রয়াগ্য একটি প্রফুল্ল গেমার এবং কাল্পনিক গল্পের অনুরাগী। তিনি গেমস এবং বইয়ের মাধ্যমে নিমজ্জনমূলক জগতগুলি অন্বেষণ করতে পছন্দ করেন, বিশেষত গল্পগুলিতে বিশেষ আগ্রহ রয়েছে যা নতুন দৃষ্টিভঙ্গি, ধারণা এবং অভিজ্ঞতা সরবরাহ করে।

title: Exclusive-US chip curbs, distillation crackdown threaten Chinese AI model development, sources say
title_bn: মার্কিন যুক্তরাষ্ট্রের একচেটিয়া চিপ নিষেধাজ্ঞা, ডিস্টিলেশন ক্রিয়া হুমকি চীনা এআই মডেলের উন্নয়ন, সূত্র বলছে
author: TechPulse
excerpt: NVIDIA-CEO-CHINA-AI:Exclusive-US chip curbs, distillation crackdown threaten Chinese AI model development, sources say
paragraph1: Nov 26 (Reuters) - China's Z.AI has fallen behind schedule on its next flagship AI model, while rival Moonshot AI expects the interval between major releases could double from six months to a year or longer if it loses access to overseas computing power, people familiar with the matter said.The previously unreported details show how efforts by US AI companies OpenAI and Anthropic to prevent distillation, a technique in which developers train models using answers generated by more capable ones, have slowed Chinese AI development. Washington's latest chip restrictions threaten further delays.The measures jeopardise a key advantage that has helped Chinese AI companies challenge their American rivals despite years of export controls: the ability to develop competitive models at substantially lower cost.A US Commerce Department rule that took effect on November 19 imposes licensing requirements aimed at restricting Chinese companies' access to large amounts of computing power from advanced US chips in overseas data centres, targeting a means of accessing Nvidia processors without importing them.Z.AI, also known as Zhipu AI, had planned to release its next flagship model, GLM-5.5, this month but has yet to do so, two people familiar with the matter said on condition of anonymity.
paragraph2: The model, designed with roughly 3 trillion parameters - a measure of its size - has been held up partly by increasingly effective safeguards against distillation, one of the people said.Z.AI had hoped to complete training and release the model by year-end, but the new US computing restrictions could push its launch into the first quarter of 2027 or later, the person said.Z.AI did not immediately respond to a request for comment.On Monday, the company released GLM-5.4, built on an existing model with 750 billion parameters. Z.AI says a new design enables it to match the performance of models with 2 trillion to 3 trillion parameters.
paragraph3: Anthropic said in September it had observed nearly 200 million exchanges with its Claude models linked to suspected distillation campaigns, attributing them to Chinese developers including Alibaba, Moonshot and Z.AI.OpenAI has made similar accusations against individuals associated with Moonshot. Anthropic has described measures it uses to detect and block unauthorised distillation, while OpenAI has also reported efforts to disrupt such activity.Moonshot did not respond immediately to a request for comment. It has previously rejected suggestions that its Kimi K3 model's performance was achieved via distillation, telling China's National Business Daily in July that its performance gains came from original changes to underlying architecture.LONGER DEVELOPMENT CYCLESBeijing-based Moonshot is particularly exposed to the new US rule because it rents computing power to train its models and prioritises overseas providers, a person with knowledge of its operations said.The AI developer internally expects its usual six-month interval between major releases could stretch to 12 months or longer if its overseas computing access is cut off entirely, the person said, adding that computing capacity available in China could not make up the shortfall.Its next flagship model, Kimi K4, could be delayed until around the middle of 2027, the person estimated.
paragraph4: Moonshot released Kimi K2 in July 2025, K2.5 in January and K3 in July.Moonshot has stepped up efforts to rent computing power in Europe, a separate person familiar with the matter said, confirming an earlier CNBC report. It plans to approach Chinese chipmakers about using their processors for training, the person added.Safeguards against distillation have also slowed Moonshot's development, the person said. As obtaining training data from Anthropic's and OpenAI's models has become increasingly difficult, Moonshot has begun distilling from models developed by Google and Meta, whose latest releases have made them attractive sources of training data, the person added.Google and Meta did not respond immediately to requests for comment.CLOSING THE CHIP LOOPHOLEThe new US restrictions on overseas data centres followed the short-lived resignation of Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang over revelations of extramarital affairs, including with unrelated Chinese businesswoman Alice Huang. Her business dealings have drawn scrutiny amid concerns about Chinese access to restricted Nvidia technology.
paragraph5: The rule covers computing arrangements at data centres outside the US above a threshold roughly equivalent to 750 of Nvidia's H100 chips, which have required US export licences for shipments to China since 2022.Operators already providing covered computing services before the rule took effect have 90 days to obtain licences.It also introduces licensing requirements for shipments of advanced chips, including H100s, to Malaysia, Singapore, Indonesia, Thailand and Brazil, with exceptions for qualifying US companies.Nvidia told its manufacturing partners to stop shipping servers to those four Southeast Asian countries, the Financial Times reported on Thursday. Nvidia did not immediately respond to a request for comment.The Information reported last week that Moonshot had scrapped a $150 million deal to access Nvidia's advanced Blackwell AI chips through an Indonesian data centre. Moonshot declined to comment to the publication.
bangla_paragraph1: ২৬ নভেম্বর (রয়টার্স) - চীনের জেড.এআই তার পরবর্তী ফ্ল্যাগশিপ এআই মডেলের সময়সূচিতে পিছিয়ে গেছে, যখন প্রতিদ্বন্দ্বী মুনশট এআই আশা করছে যে এটি বিদেশের কম্পিউটিং শক্তিতে অ্যাক্সেস হারানোর ক্ষেত্রে বড় রিলিজের মধ্যে ব্যবধান ছয় মাস থেকে এক বছর বা তারও বেশি সময় দ্বিগুণ হতে পারে।
bangla_paragraph2: প্রায় ৩ ট্রিলিয়ন পরামিতির সাথে ডিজাইন করা মডেলটি - এর আকারের পরিমাপ - এর একটি অংশ ডিস্টিলেশনের বিরুদ্ধে ক্রমবর্ধমান কার্যকর সুরক্ষা দ্বারা আংশিকভাবে আটকে রাখা হয়েছে, এক ব্যক্তি বলেছিলেন। Z.AI বছরের শেষ নাগাদ প্রশিক্ষণ শেষ করার এবং মডেল প্রকাশের আশা করেছিল, তবে মার্কিন যুক্তরাষ্ট্রের নতুন কম্পিউটিং বিধিনিষেধগুলি 2027 সালের প্রথম প্রান্তিকে বা তার পরেও তার প্রবর্তনকে ঠেলে দিতে পারে, ব্যক্তিটি বলেছিলেন।
bangla_paragraph3: এন্থ্রপিক সেপ্টেম্বরে বলেছিল যে তারা সন্দেহজনক নিষ্কাশন প্রচারের সাথে যুক্ত ক্লাউড মডেলগুলির সাথে প্রায় ২০০ মিলিয়ন বিনিময় পর্যবেক্ষণ করেছে, এগুলি আলিবাবা, মুনশট এবং জেডএআই সহ চীনা বিকাশকারীদের কাছে দায়ী করেছে। ওপেনএআই মুনসটের সাথে যুক্ত ব্যক্তিদের বিরুদ্ধে অনুরূপ অভিযোগ করেছে। এন্থ্ৰপিক অননুমোদিত নিষ্কাষণ সনাক্ত এবং ব্লক করার জন্য এটি যে ব্যবস্থা গ্রহণ করে তা বর্ণনা করেছে, যখন ওপেনএইআইও এই ধরনের কার্যকলাপ ব্যাহত করার প্রচেষ্টা জানিয়েছে। মুনশাট অবিলম্বে কোনও অনুরোধের প্রতিক্রিয়া জানায়নি
bangla_paragraph4: মুনশট ২০২৫ সালের জুলাইয়ে কিমি কে২, জানুয়ারিতে কে২.৫ এবং জুলাইয়ে কে৩ প্রকাশ করেছে। মুনসট ইউরোপে কম্পিউটিং শক্তি ভাড়া দেওয়ার প্রচেষ্টা জোরদার করেছে, বিষয়টি সম্পর্কে পরিচিত একটি পৃথক ব্যক্তি বলেছেন, একটি পূর্ববর্তী সিএনবিসি রিপোর্ট নিশ্চিত করে। এটি প্রশিক্ষণের জন্য তাদের প্রসেসর ব্যবহারের বিষয়ে চীনা চিপ নির্মাতাদের কাছে যাওয়ার পরিকল্পনা করেছে, ব্যক্তিটি যোগ করেছেন। নিষ্কাশনের বিরুদ্ধে সুরক্ষা ব্যবস্থাও মুন শটের বিকাশকে ধীর করে দিয়েছে, ব্যক্তি বলেছেন। যেমনটি অ্যানথ্রপিক এবং ওপেনএআই এর মডেল থেকে প্রশিক্ষণ ডেটা পাওয়া ক্রমবর্ধমান হয়ে উঠেছে
bangla_paragraph5: এই নিয়মটি মার্কিন যুক্তরাষ্ট্রের বাইরে ডেটা সেন্টারে কম্পিউটিং ব্যবস্থাগুলিকে প্রায় 750 টি এনভিডিয়ার এইচ 100 চিপের সমতুল্য একটি থ্রেশহোল্ডের উপরে কভার করে, যা 2022 সাল থেকে চীনে চালানের জন্য মার্কিন রপ্তানি লাইসেন্সের প্রয়োজন। নিয়মটি কার্যকর হওয়ার আগে ইতিমধ্যে কভার করা কম্পিউটিং পরিষেবা সরবরাহকারী অপারেটরদের লাইসেন্সিং পাওয়ার জন্য 90 দিন সময় রয়েছে। এটি মালয়েশিয়া, সিঙ্গাপুর, ইন্দোনেশিয়া , থাইল্যান্ড এবং ব্রাজিলের জন্য এইচ100 সহ উন্নত চিপগুলির চালানের লাইসেন্সিংয়ের প্রয়োজনীয়তাও প্রবর্তন করে, যোগ্যতা অর্জনের ব্যতিক্রম সহ।

title: US chip curbs, distillation crackdown threaten Chinese AI model development, sources say
title_bn: মার্কিন চিপ নিষেধাজ্ঞা, ডিস্টিলেশন কঠোর ব্যবস্থা চীনের এআই মডেলের উন্নয়নের হুমকি, সূত্র বলছে
author: TechPulse
excerpt: NVIDIA-CEO/CHINA-AI (EXCLUSIVE, PIX):EXCLUSIVE-US chip curbs, distillation crackdown threaten Chinese AI model development, sources say
paragraph1: * Z.AI's next flagship model could be delayed until 2027, sources say* Moonshot expects development cycles could double without overseas computing access, sources say* New US chip curbs, anti-distillation measures threaten China's low-cost AI development model, sources sayNov 26 (Reuters) - China's Z.AI has fallen behind schedule on its next flagship AI model, while rival Moonshot AI expects the interval between major releases could double from six months to a year or longer if it loses access to overseas computing power, people familiar with the matter said.The previously unreported details show how efforts by US AI companies OpenAI and Anthropic to prevent distillation, a technique in which developers train models using answers generated by more capable ones, have slowed Chinese AI development. Washington's latest chip restrictions threaten further delays.The measures jeopardise a key advantage that has helped Chinese AI companies challenge their American rivals despite years of export controls: the ability to develop competitive models at substantially lower cost.A US Commerce Department rule that took effect on November 19 imposes licensing requirements aimed at restricting Chinese companies' access to large amounts of computing power from advanced US chips in overseas data centres, targeting a means of accessing Nvidia processors without importing them.Z.AI, also known as Zhipu AI, had planned to release its next flagship model, GLM-5.
paragraph2: 5, this month but has yet to do so, two people familiar with the matter said on condition of anonymity.The model, designed with roughly 3 trillion parameters - a measure of its size - has been held up partly by increasingly effective safeguards against distillation, one of the people said.Z.AI had hoped to complete training and release the model by year-end, but the new US computing restrictions could push its launch into the first quarter of 2027 or later, the person said.Z.AI did not immediately respond to a request for comment.On Monday, the company released GLM-5.4, built on an existing model with 750 billion parameters. Z.
paragraph3: AI says a new design enables it to match the performance of models with 2 trillion to 3 trillion parameters.Anthropic said in September it had observed nearly 200 million exchanges with its Claude models linked to suspected distillation campaigns, attributing them to Chinese developers including Alibaba, Moonshot and Z.AI.OpenAI has made similar accusations against individuals associated with Moonshot. Anthropic has described measures it uses to detect and block unauthorised distillation, while OpenAI has also reported efforts to disrupt such activity.Moonshot did not respond immediately to a request for comment. It has previously rejected suggestions that its Kimi K3 model's performance was achieved via distillation, telling China's National Business Daily in July that its performance gains came from original changes to underlying architecture.LONGER DEVELOPMENT CYCLESBeijing-based Moonshot is particularly exposed to the new US rule because it rents computing power to train its models and prioritises overseas providers, a person with knowledge of its operations said.The AI developer internally expects its usual six-month interval between major releases could stretch to 12 months or longer if its overseas computing access is cut off entirely, the person said, adding that computing capacity available in China could not make up the shortfall.
paragraph4: Its next flagship model, Kimi K4, could be delayed until around the middle of 2027, the person estimated. Moonshot released Kimi K2 in July 2025, K2.5 in January and K3 in July.Moonshot has stepped up efforts to rent computing power in Europe, a separate person familiar with the matter said, confirming an earlier CNBC report. It plans to approach Chinese chipmakers about using their processors for training, the person added.Safeguards against distillation have also slowed Moonshot's development, the person said. As obtaining training data from Anthropic's and OpenAI's models has become increasingly difficult, Moonshot has begun distilling from models developed by Google and Meta, whose latest releases have made them attractive sources of training data, the person added.Google and Meta did not respond immediately to requests for comment.CLOSING THE CHIP LOOPHOLEThe new US restrictions on overseas data centres followed the short-lived resignation of Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang over revelations of extramarital affairs, including with unrelated Chinese businesswoman Alice Huang.
paragraph5: Her business dealings have drawn scrutiny amid concerns about Chinese access to restricted Nvidia technology.The rule covers computing arrangements at data centres outside the US above a threshold roughly equivalent to 750 of Nvidia's H100 chips, which have required US export licences for shipments to China since 2022.Operators already providing covered computing services before the rule took effect have 90 days to obtain licences.It also introduces licensing requirements for shipments of advanced chips, including H100s, to Malaysia, Singapore, Indonesia, Thailand and Brazil, with exceptions for qualifying US companies.Nvidia told its manufacturing partners to stop shipping servers to those four Southeast Asian countries, the Financial Times reported on Thursday. Nvidia did not immediately respond to a request for comment.The Information reported last week that Moonshot had scrapped a $150 million deal to access Nvidia's advanced Blackwell AI chips through an Indonesian data centre. Moonshot declined to comment to the publication.

bangla_paragraph4: মুনশট ২০২৫ সালের জুলাইয়ে কিমি কে২, জানুয়ারিতে কে২.৫ এবং জুলাইয়ে কে৩ প্রকাশ করেছে। মুনসট ইউরোপে কম্পিউটিং শক্তি ভাড়া নেওয়ার প্রচেষ্টা জোরদার করেছে, বিষয়টি সম্পর্কে পরিচিত একজন পৃথক ব্যক্তি বলেছেন, একটি পূর্ববর্তী সিএনবিসি রিপোর্ট নিশ্চিত করে। এটি প্রশিক্ষণের জন্য তাদের প্রসেসর ব্যবহারের বিষয়ে চীনা চিপ নির্মাতাদের কাছে যাওয়ার পরিকল্পনা করেছে, ব্যক্তি যোগ করেছেন। নিষ্কাশনের বিরুদ্ধে সুরক্ষা মুনশাটের বিকাশকেও ধীর করেছে,

title: Samsung brings Galaxy Watch 9's health features to Galaxy Watch 8: Check all new One UI 9 additions
title_bn: স্যামসাং গ্যালাক্সি ওয়াচ ৮-এ গ্যাল্যাক্সি ঘড়ি ৯-এর স্বাস্থ্য বৈশিষ্ট্য নিয়ে আসেঃ নতুন ওয়ান ইউআই ৯-এ যোগ করা সমস্ত বৈশিষ্ট্য দেখুন
author: TechPulse
excerpt: Samsung is rolling out the One UI 9 Watch update for the Galaxy Watch 8 and Watch 8 Classic, adding Heart Health Score, Vitals, Daily Cardio Load and upgraded Sleep Apnea monitoring. The update also brings personalised Sleep Coaching, improved fitnes
paragraph1: Samsung is rolling out the One UI 9 Watch update for the Galaxy Watch 8 and Watch 8 Classic, adding Heart Health Score, Vitals, Daily Cardio Load and upgraded Sleep Apnea monitoring. The update also brings personalised Sleep Coaching, improved fitness tracking and new navigation features.Samsung is rolling out the One UI 9 Watch update for the Galaxy Watch 8 and Watch 8 Classic.Samsung has started rolling out its One UI 9 Watch update for the Galaxy Watch 8 and Galaxy Watch 8 Classic, bringing several new health and fitness features to the smartwatches. The update has been rolling out since mid-November and adds functionality seen on the Galaxy Watch 9 series and Galaxy Watch Ultra 2. The update includes Heart Health Score, Vitals, Daily Cardio Load and Fitness Index, which are made possible with the introduction of Wear OS 7. Samsung announced the rollout through a blog post on Wednesday, 25 November.
paragraph2: These new features are available via the Samsung Health application and Samsung Health Monitor, but some may require app updates. Availability is subject to country, watch model and carrier. Samsung Galaxy Watch 8 gets new heart health and fitness features Heart Health Score gives users an overall idea of their heart health by combining indicators such as sleep and physical activity. It also enables users to track their scores over time.Samsung is also introducing Vitals, which tracks five health indicators during sleep: heart rate, heart rate variability, respiratory rate, skin temperature and blood oxygen levels. The feature sets a baseline and informs the user if significant changes are detected. However, users must collect at least seven nights of sleep data before accessing these insights.
paragraph3: Daily cardio load is another addition to the update, which is a calculation of the load placed on the heart by physical activity and daily living. Fitness Index, on the other hand, combines multiple fitness metrics to provide users with an overview of physical fitness and activity recommendations tailored to their goals.Sleep coaching and sleep apnoea monitoring get upgradesSamsung has also improved its Sleep Coaching feature by providing more personalized recommendations based on users' sleep patterns and goals. It can start guiding users with three days of sleep data collected over 14 days. Users get a sleep routine checklist and suggestions to improve their sleep.The other big addition is the improved sleep apnoea monitoring system. The feature is available in the Samsung Health Monitor app, which uses an AI-based algorithm to detect breathing disruptions while sleeping.
paragraph4: It classifies the results into three categories: minimal, occasional and frequent. Users require at least two nights of sleep data within 10 days to get results.According to Samsung, the feature received US Food and Drug Administration (FDA) clearance in July and approval from South Korea’s Ministry of Food and Drug Safety in October.Samsung Galaxy Watch 8 update brings new navigation featuresOne UI 9 Watch adds a Portrait Watch Face that automatically arranges the clock around the people in selected photos. Samsung has also improved the Compass app, allowing users to save important locations as waypoints.Users can now replay a track they have recorded and return to the starting point with the new Track Back feature.(With agency inputs)About the AuthorPragya Singha RoyPragya is a Technology reporter with over four years of experience in digital media and content writing.
paragraph5: She holds a Master’s degree in Journalism and has covered a wide range of stories spanning space, smartphones, gadgets, artificial intelligence, emerging technologies and the ways technology is transforming everyday life. She focuses on breaking down complex technology and science developments into clear, engaging, and reader-friendly stories, with a keen interest in emerging trends and their real-world impact. Before joining her current newsroom, Pragya worked with News9Live, where she covered the technology beat extensively, reporting on smartphones, consumer technology, AI, space and science, while also contributing to video and visual content. Her experience includes breaking news, explainers, SEO-driven stories, product coverage, interviews, unboxing videos and live event reporting. She has also covered major technology and AI events, giving her experience in both newsroom and on-ground reporting. Beyond journalism, Pragya is an avid gamer and a passionate reader of fiction. She enjoys exploring immersive worlds through games and books, with a particular interest in stories that offer new perspectives, ideas, and experiences.
bangla_paragraph1: স্যামসাং গ্যালাক্সি ওয়াচ ৮ এবং ওয়াচ৮ ক্লাসিকের জন্য ওয়ান ইউআই ৯ ওয়াচ আপডেট চালু করছে, এতে হার্ট হেলথ স্কোর, ভিটালস, দৈনিক কার্ডিও লোড এবং আপগ্রেড করা স্লিপ অ্যাপনিয়া মনিটরিং যুক্ত করা হয়েছে। আপডেটে ব্যক্তিগতকৃত স্লিপের কোচিং, উন্নত ফিটনেস ট্র্যাকিং এবং নতুন নেভিগেশন বৈশিষ্ট্যও রয়েছে। স্যামসুং গালাক্সী ওয়াচ ८ এবং ওয়াজ ৮ ক্লাসিকার জন্য ওয়াইউআই ৯ওয়াচ আপডেইট চালু করেছে। সামসুং তার ওয়ান UI ৯ ওয়াচের আপডেটের জন্য গ্যাল্যাক্সিওয়াচ ৮ ও গ্যালাকি ওয়াচ ୮ ক্লাসিক্স চালু করতে শুরু করেছে, যা s নিয়ে এসেছে।
bangla_paragraph2: এই নতুন বৈশিষ্ট্যগুলি স্যামসাং হেলথ অ্যাপ্লিকেশন এবং স্যামসুং হেল্থ মনিটরের মাধ্যমে উপলব্ধ, তবে কিছু অ্যাপ্লিকেশনের আপডেটের প্রয়োজন হতে পারে। উপলভ্যতা দেশ, ঘড়ি মডেল এবং ক্যারিয়ারের সাপেক্ষে। স্যামসং গ্যালাক্সি ওয়াচ 8 নতুন হার্ট স্বাস্থ্য এবং ফিটনেস বৈশিষ্ট্যগুলি পায়। হার্ট হেলথ স্কোর ব্যবহারকারীদের ঘুম এবং শারীরিক ক্রিয়াকলাপের মতো সূচকগুলির সংমিশ্রণে তাদের হৃদয়ের স্বাস্থ্যের সামগ্রিক ধারণা দেয়। এটি ব্যবহারকারীদের সময়ের সাথে সাথে তাদের স্কোরগুলি ট্র্যাক করতে সক্ষম করে। সামসাং ভিটালসও চালু করছে, যা পাঁচটি স্বাস্থ্য ট্র্যাক করে।
bangla_paragraph3: দৈনিক কার্ডিও লোড আপডেটের আরেকটি সংযোজন, যা শারীরিক ক্রিয়াকলাপ এবং দৈনন্দিন জীবনযাত্রার দ্বারা হৃদয়ে চাপের গণনা। ফিটনেস সূচক, অন্যদিকে, ব্যবহারকারীদের তাদের লক্ষ্যগুলির সাথে খাপ খাইয়ে নেওয়া শারীরীক ফিটनेस এবং ক্রিয়াকাণ্ডের সুপারিশগুলির একটি ওভারভিউ সরবরাহ করতে একাধিক ফিটনেট মেট্রিক্সকে একত্রিত করে। ঘুম প্রশিক্ষণ এবং ঘুমের অ্যাপোনিয়া পর্যবেক্ষণ আপগ্রেড পান। স্যামসুং ব্যবহারকারীদের ঘুমের উপর ভিত্তি করে আরও ব্যক্তিগতকৃত সুপারির মাধ্যমে তার ঘুম প্রশিক্ষণের বৈশিষ্ট্যটি উন্নত করেছে।
bangla_paragraph4: এটি ফলাফলগুলিকে তিনটি বিভাগে শ্রেণীবদ্ধ করেঃ ন্যূনতম, মাঝে মাঝে এবং ঘন ঘন। ব্যবহারকারীদের ফলাফল পেতে 10 দিনের মধ্যে কমপক্ষে দুই রাতের ঘুমের ডেটা প্রয়োজন। স্যামসাংয়ের মতে, বৈশিষ্ট্যটি জুলাইয়ে মার্কিন খাদ্য ও ওষুধ প্রশাসন (এফডিএ) থেকে ছাড়পত্র এবং অক্টোবরে দক্ষিণ কোরিয়ার খাদ্য ও ড্রাগ সুরক্ষা মন্ত্রকের অনুমোদন পেয়েছে। সামসাং গ্যালাক্সি ওয়াচ 8 আপডেট নতুন নেভিগেশন বৈশিষ্ট্য নিয়ে আসে।
bangla_paragraph5: তিনি সাংবাদিকতায় স্নাতকোত্তর ডিগ্রি অর্জন করেছেন এবং মহাকাশ, স্মার্টফোন, গ্যাজেট, কৃত্রিম বুদ্ধিমত্তা, উদীয়মান প্রযুক্তি এবং প্রযুক্তি দৈনন্দিন জীবনকে রূপান্তরিত করার উপায়গুলি জুড়ে বিস্তৃত গল্পগুলি কভার করেছেন। তিনি উদীয়ম প্রবণতা এবং তাদের বাস্তব বিশ্বের প্রভাবের প্রতি গভীর আগ্রহের সাথে জটিল প্রযুক্তি এবং বিজ্ঞান উন্নয়নগুলিকে পরিষ্কার, আকর্ষক এবং পাঠক-বান্ধব গল্পগুলিতে ভেঙে দেওয়ার দিকে মনোনিবেশ করেন। তার বর্তমান নিউজরুমে যোগদানের আগে, প্রজ্ঞা নিউজ৯লাইভের সাথে কাজ করেছিলেন, যেখানে তিনি

title: Data from Chinese AI firm MiniMax accessed by unidentified parties, researcher says
title_bn: চীনা এআই ফার্ম মিনিম্যাক্সের তথ্য অজ্ঞাত ব্যক্তিদের দ্বারা অ্যাক্সেস করা হয়েছে, গবেষক বলেছেন
author: TechPulse
excerpt: AI-CHINA/MINIMAX (EXCLUSIVE, PIX):EXCLUSIVE-Data from Chinese AI firm MiniMax accessed by unidentified parties, researcher says
paragraph1: * Researcher identifies MiniMax in previously anonymous AI data-security investigation* Private links opened days or weeks later; attempts made to retrieve software code* Atlas Cloud warns customers to treat sensitive information sent to MiniMax as exposedBy Wen-Yee Lee and Fanny PotkinTAIPEI/SINGAPORE, Nov 26 (Reuters) - Confidential data submitted to Chinese AI startup MiniMax was accessed by unidentified parties, a cybersecurity researcher told Reuters, even after users requested that their data not be stored or retained.HD Moore, chief research officer at US cybersecurity firm Dragos, identified MiniMax as the Chinese AI developer that was referred to in the firm's earlier investigation into AI data security. The investigation, detailed in a November 19 blog post that did not name MiniMax, found that private web links embedded in requests that were submitted to AI services were subsequently accessed by unauthorized parties.Moore said one secret link sent to MiniMax appeared in a chat channel on Feishu, a workplace messaging platform developed by China's ByteDance, weeks later and was opened by devices in Beijing and Shanghai.Researchers also detected unusual internet activity from the Moscow region involving links submitted to MiniMax, although the evidence did not establish that the links were opened from Russia.Dragos' public identification of MiniMax as the Chinese AI startup that had data submitted to it that was accessed by unidentified parties is being reported here for the first time, as are the findings involving Russia.
paragraph2: MiniMax, which listed its shares in Hong Kong earlier this year, develops multimodal AI models - which can process multiple types of data - and consumer applications.Atlas Cloud, a US-based AI service provider that offers access to MiniMax's models, was among the companies affected by the data exposure. A spokesperson said it chose to use MiniMax’s data centres in Singapore to avoid having customer data processed in China, but information submitted through its platform was potentially exposed after reaching MiniMax.Dragos' findings raise questions about the security of confidential software, financial records and customer information as Chinese AI models attract users from around the world with lower prices and increasingly powerful capabilities.Chinese models were the three most widely used on AI platform OpenRouter in October, measured by the amount of text processed, as Washington considers requiring American companies to disclose their use of Chinese AI.In a statement on Tuesday, MiniMax said its security system had collected and stored web links contained in messages sent to its AI models through other service providers.
paragraph3: The system automatically opened some of those links to check for potential security threats.MiniMax said it did not retain full conversations and had deleted the stored addresses. The firm said the activity had stopped and it had found no evidence, in the requests it examined, that customer conversations or AI responses had been disclosed to third parties.In response, Atlas Cloud said on Tuesday that MiniMax's explanation was consistent with its findings that the links embedded in user prompts were accessed after those prompts were forwarded to MiniMax, rather than on Atlas Cloud's own systems.Atlas Cloud said it stopped forwarding requests to MiniMax and warned customers who used its M3, M2.7 or M3.
paragraph4: 1 Flash models to treat any secrets submitted as potentially exposed.AI platform OpenRouter said it removed three providers, tightened its data privacy requirements and notified all potentially affected customers. It found no evidence that its systems had been breached.PRIVATE LINKS ACCESSEDDragos sent nearly 2 million requests containing secret web links and test login details to AI providers between July and November, then monitored whether anyone subsequently tried to access them.Moore said links sent through different providers were repeatedly opened two to three days later from an internet connection in Singapore, including when customers requested that their information not be stored.The pattern appeared only when requests were forwarded to MiniMax's cloud, not when other companies ran its models independently, Moore said.
paragraph5: Dragos researchers also detected attempts to download private collections of software code that were referenced in MiniMax requests. Moore said researchers observed this new activity after the scraping of secret links appeared to stop on October 22. It was unclear who initiated the attempts or whether any code was obtained.MiniMax did not address the attempted software downloads or the Feishu incident in its public statement.

bangla_paragraph2: মিনিম্যাক্স, যা এই বছরের শুরুর দিকে হংকংয়ে তার শেয়ার তালিকাভুক্ত করেছিল, মাল্টিমোডাল এআই মডেলগুলি বিকাশ করে - যা একাধিক ধরণের ডেটা প্রক্রিয়া করতে পারে - এবং ভোক্তা অ্যাপ্লিকেশন। মার্কিন যুক্তরাষ্ট্র ভিত্তিক এআই পরিষেবা সরবরাহকারী অ্যাটলাস ক্লাউড, যা মিনিমাক্সের মডেলগুলিতে অ্যাক্সেস সরবরাহ করে, ডেটা এক্সপোজারে ক্ষতিগ্রস্থ সংস্থাগুলির মধ্যে ছিল। একজন মুখপাত্র বলেছেন যে এটি চীনে গ্রাহকের ডেটা প্রক্রিয়াকরণ এড়াতে সিঙ্গাপুরে মিনিম্যাক্সের ডেটা সেন্টারগুলি ব্যবহার করতে বেছে নিয়েছে, তবে এর প্ল্যাটফর্মের মাধ্যমে জমা দেওয়া তথ্য সম্ভাব্যভাবে প্রকাশিত হয়েছিল।

title: 1Password confirms hackers stole customer data, but not their passwords
title_bn: 1 পাসওয়ার্ড নিশ্চিত করেছে হ্যাকাররা গ্রাহকের তথ্য চুরি করেছে, কিন্তু তাদের পাসওয়র্ড নয়
author: TechPulse
excerpt: Watch out for unexpected recovery emails and invitations.
paragraph1: 1PasswordAdd Android Authority on Google: TL;DR 1Password has confirmed a security breach that exposed some customers’ personal information, including names and email addresses. The company says no customer passwords were exposed and that users don’t need to change their account or saved passwords. 1Password recommends watching out for unexpected account recovery emails and invitations following the breach. Trust is everything when you’re in the business of keeping people’s passwords safe.
paragraph2: It’s a responsibility that has only grown for 1Password in recent months, with the company enabling Claude and, more recently, other AI agents to sign into websites without exposing users’ credentials. That trust is now being put to the test after 1Password confirmed a security breach that exposed some customer information, although it maintains that users’ passwords are safe.In a blog post published on November 25, 1Password revealed that it began investigating the breach on November 19 after detecting suspicious activity involving an employee’s corporate GitHub account. The attacker gained access to the company’s source code and compromised backend services, obtaining customer names, email addresses, account identifiers, and other account information.
paragraph3: However, 1Password maintains that neither customer vaults nor the encryption keys protecting them were compromised. The company doesn’t store your account password or Secret Key, so you don’t need to change your 1Password password or any passwords saved in your vault. The company says it has secured the affected systems, changed potentially exposed internal credentials, and strengthened its account recovery and invitation verification process. It hasn’t disclosed how many customers were affected.
paragraph4: This isn’t 1Password’s first security scare. In October 2023, the company disclosed an incident linked to a breach at Okta, although no customer data was accessed at the time. Rival LastPass suffered a more serious breach in 2022, with hackers eventually obtaining copies of customer password vaults. As recently as June 2026, LastPass suffered another data breach that exposed customers’ personal information but left their saved passwords untouched.
paragraph5: For now, 1Password users should be particularly wary of unexpected account recovery emails and invitations. Hackers could use the stolen information to make phishing attempts more convincing. So if the incident makes you uncomfortable sticking with 1Password, Android has a safer way to move passwords and passkeys between password managers without exporting your entire vault in plain text.

author: TechPulse
excerpt: Apple will open its first Hyderabad retail store, Apple Kukatpally, on December 10 at Lake Shore-Y Junction Mall, taking its India store count to seven. Customers will get access to Apple's latest products, expert support and free Today at Apple crea
paragraph1: Apple will open its first Hyderabad retail store, Apple Kukatpally, on December 10 at Lake Shore-Y Junction Mall, taking its India store count to seven. Customers will get access to Apple's latest products, expert support and free Today at Apple creative sessions.Apple will open its first Hyderabad retail store.Apple is set to open its first official retail store in Hyderabad on December 10, expanding its physical retail presence in India to seven outlets. The new store will be named Apple Kukatpally, set up at Lake Shore-Y Junction mall in Telangana, and will open to customers at 5 PM IST. The launch is part of Apple's recent efforts to strengthen its retail footprint in one of the nation's key technology and business hubs, according to Apple Newsroom and Apple's official India retail website.
paragraph2: The company announced the opening on November 26, revealing the store's barricade design ahead of its launch. The design is inspired by the Apple logo, with its colour palette drawn from the colours of Hyderabad, the 'City of Pearls'. The design honours the city's cultural heritage and its history with pearls, says Apple.Apple Kukatpally store: Products and services customers can expectThe new outlet will also provide an opportunity for customers to discover Apple's lineup of devices, including the latest iPhone models, MacBook Pro, Apple Watch, AirPods, and HomePod. They will also be able to access Apple's in-store support services via Specialists, Creatives, Geniuses and dedicated Business teams.Apple will also be hosting free ‘Today at Apple' events daily at its Hyderabad store.
paragraph3: The topics will include Photography, Video Making, Drawing and Starting with Apple Devices. These workshops are for customers to help them understand how to use their iPhone, iPad and Apple Watch.Apple has also shared some exclusive Apple Kukatpally wallpapers and stickers ahead of the launch. The company has also launched a special Apple Music playlist featuring local sounds and culture of Hyderabad. They can be found on Apple's official retail website.Apple stores in India: Full listWith the Apple Kukatpally store, the company's official retail network in India will increase to seven stores.
paragraph4: Its existing outlets include:Mumbai: Apple BKC and Apple BorivaliDelhi NCR: Apple Saket and Apple NoidaBengaluru: Apple HebbalPune: Apple Koregaon ParkHyderabad: Apple Kukatpally (opening December 10)Hyderabad is already a key city for Apple's operations in India, as the city has the Research, Development and Retail Customer Care businesses. The store's opening is expected to further improve its connection with its customers in the city.It's also possible to buy Apple products online via the company's online store or via the Apple Store app or Shop with a Specialist services, which supply personalised help through calls and chats.About the AuthorPragya Singha RoyPragya is a Technology reporter with over four years of experience in digital media and content writing. She holds a Master’s degree in Journalism and has covered a wide range of stories spanning space, smartphones, gadgets, artificial intelligence, emerging technologies and the ways technology is transforming everyday life. She focuses on breaking down complex technology and science developments into clear, engaging, and reader-friendly stories, with a keen interest in emerging trends and their real-world impact.
paragraph5: Before joining her current newsroom, Pragya worked with News9Live, where she covered the technology beat extensively, reporting on smartphones, consumer technology, AI, space and science, while also contributing to video and visual content. Her experience includes breaking news, explainers, SEO-driven stories, product coverage, interviews, unboxing videos and live event reporting. She has also covered major technology and AI events, giving her experience in both newsroom and on-ground reporting. Beyond journalism, Pragya is an avid gamer and a passionate reader of fiction. She enjoys exploring immersive worlds through games and books, with a particular interest in stories that offer new perspectives, ideas, and experiences.

title: Uber Appoints Former Zomato Food Delivery CEO Rakesh Ranjan As India President
title_bn: উবার ভারতের প্রেসিডেন্ট হিসেবে জোমাতোর সাবেক ফুড ডেলিভারি প্রধান নির্বাহী কর্মকর্তা রাকেশ রঞ্জনকে নিয়োগ করেছে।
author: TechPulse
excerpt: Uber has appointed former Zomato food delivery CEO Rakesh Ranjan as its president for India and South Asia, as the…
paragraph1: SUMMARYUber has appointed former Zomato food delivery CEO Rakesh Ranjan as president of India and South Asia, effective January 4, 2027. The appointment comes as India remains Uber’s third-largest market globally by trips and a key contributor to its growth ambitions. Ranjan spent eight years at Zomato and joins Uber from Allen Online, where he is the current CEO. Uber has appointed former Zomato food delivery CEO Rakesh Ranjan as its president for India and South Asia, as the ride-hailing platform looks to strengthen its presence in one of its largest global markets. Ranjan will assume the role on January 4, 2027, and report to Dom Taylor, Uber’s regional general manager for Asia Pacific.
paragraph2: He will join Uber from edtech platform Allen Online, where he is currently the CEO. Prior to that, Ranjan spent eight years at Zomato, joining the foodtech company in 2017. During his stint, the ISB alumnus held leadership positions across Zomato Gold and sales before taking charge as CEO of its B2B offering Hyperpure, and eventually the food ordering and delivery business. The appointment follows a search process spanning more than three months, according to Uber. Former president Prabhjet Singh, who held the post for 11 years, left Uber India in July to join OpenAI as its India MD.
paragraph3: Commenting on the appointment, Taylor said Ranjan’s experience in running large consumer businesses in India and his understanding of the market made him a suitable fit to lead the company’s next phase of growth in the region. Uber’s India Growth Ambitions India is Uber’s third-largest market globally by trips, behind the US and Brazil, and its second-largest market by number of earners. The company operates in more than 225 cities in India, with over two million monthly active drivers earning through its platform. India is also home to Uber’s largest technology centres outside the US, located in Bengaluru and Hyderabad, the company said. It is also setting up its first data centre in India in partnership with the Adani Group.
paragraph4: Uber entered India in 2013 and has since expanded its mobility offerings beyond cabs to include bikes, autos and metro services. Ranjan’s appointment comes as Uber looks to build on this scale by improving ride reliability, expanding value-oriented mobility options, and creating better earning opportunities for drivers. In a statement, Ranjan said his priorities would include improving everyday customer experiences through dependable rides, offering value across different journeys and creating better earning opportunities for drivers. India is expected to contribute a significant share of Uber’s global growth, the company said. Earlier this year, Uber infused ₹2,921 Cr into its India arm, as competition intensified in the country’s ride-hailing market, especially from Rapido, which is currently its biggest competitor.
paragraph5: Uber also undertook internal restructuring earlier this year, which saw the company lay off around 200-250 employees in India in September as part of a global layoff exercise that culled 3,300 roles across functions. The layoffs, which impacted both individual contributors and managers, came barely six months after Uber cut around 80 jobs in the country. Despite healthy demand, Uber has been facing issues at multiple fronts in emerging markets like India and Brazil, including a mismatch in driver supply and elevated fuel prices. Since these are price sensitive markets, Uber is rejigging driver and rider incentives to retain supply, the company said during its Q4 2026 earnings call this month.

title: Nothing Ear (note) design revealed ahead of 8 December launch: AI recording, transcription and TALK buttons confirmed
title_bn: Nothing Ear (note) design revealed ahead of 8 December launch: AI recording, transcription and TALK buttons confirmed
author: TechPulse
excerpt: Nothing has revealed the design of its Ear (note) AI earbuds ahead of the 8 December launch, showing a metallic charging case with dedicated TALK and RECORD buttons. The earbuds are expected to support AI-powered call recording, meeting transcription
paragraph1: Nothing has revealed the design of its Ear (note) AI earbuds ahead of the 8 December launch, showing a metallic charging case with dedicated TALK and RECORD buttons. The earbuds are expected to support AI-powered call recording, meeting transcription, summaries and Hi-Res Audio.Nothing has revealed the design of its Ear (note) AI earbuds.Nothing has revealed the design of its upcoming Ear (note) earbuds ahead of their 8 December launch. On 26 November, the tech start-up released a “teaser” video on X, featuring a pair of transparent headsets and a metallic charging case with separate ‘TALK' and ‘RECORD' buttons. The device is expected to be Nothing's first AI-powered hardware offering, featuring wireless audio, voice recording, transcription and AI assistance.The new earbuds will be able to capture conversations, such as phone calls and face-to-face meetings, and transform them into valuable insights using AI. Nothing has also confirmed Hi-Res Audio support and states the Ear (note) will provide its highest level of in-ear sound yet.
paragraph2: The company hasn't revealed the price or full details of the variant yet.Watch videoNothing Ear (note) design and features revealed The teaser reveals that the new charging case is square and features two transparent panels that let you peek at the earbuds inside– which are metallic. There are dedicated TALK and RECORD buttons, an LED indicator and a USB Type-C charging port. There are also three more white LED lights visible, used to indicate the remaining battery level.The earbuds feature Nothing's signature transparent design and white stems that are marked with 'ear (note)'. The teaser also gives an up-close view of the internal driver assembly. There are two circular holes in the rear of the case, seemingly for microphones.Nothing Ear (note) AI recording and transcription featuresNothing CEO Carl Pei previously discussed the device's capabilities in an interview with Bloomberg.
paragraph3: Pei said users will be able to start recordings with a dedicated button. The earbuds will likely be used for phone calls, and the built-in microphones in the charging case will record face-to-face conversations and conferences.The app could produce transcripts and summaries so that users can go back and review key conversations. The device will also support numerous AI agents via voice control, along with Nothing's voice assistant.Pei said that the product is the first step to introducing a hardware context layer for AI. It's about having AI agents use recorded conversations and take actions like drafting documents, drafting emails and assigning work.Nothing Ear (note) launch date, availability and expected priceRecording conversations raises questions about user privacy. The company reportedly met with law firms and had begun privacy certifications for the device.

title: Green Aero Raises $14 Mn To Build Jet Engines, Combat Drones
title_bn: গ্রিন এয়ারো জেট ইঞ্জিন, যুদ্ধবিমান তৈরির জন্য ১৪ মিলিয়ন ডলার সংগ্রহ করেছে
author: TechPulse
excerpt: Deeptech startup Green Aero has raised $14 Mn (₹129.2 Cr) in a Series A funding round led by Crane Ventures,…
paragraph1: SUMMARYGreen Aero has raised $14 Mn (₹129.2 Cr) in a Series A funding round led by Crane Ventures Green Aero is now looking to develop engines in the four-kilonewton-plus category over the next three years, Kundu told Inc42. Founded in 2023 by Prithwish Kundu, Green Aero is developing jet propulsion systems, avionics and airframes for high-speed drones Deeptech startup Green Aero has raised $14 Mn (₹129.2 Cr) in a Series A funding round led by Crane Ventures, as it looks to scale indigenous jet engine development and build autonomous combat aircraft for India and global markets. The round also saw participation from 3one4 Capital, Antler Elevate, and existing investors pi Ventures, Antler India, and Rebalance. Founded in 2023 by Prithwish Kundu, Green Aero is developing jet propulsion systems, avionics and airframes for high-speed drones and autonomous combat aircraft.
paragraph2: It will deploy the capital over the next 12-18 months to expand its engine testing infrastructure, hire engineers, develop larger-thrust engines and accelerate flight qualification of its transonic and supersonic drone platforms. The startup is also looking to commercialise its existing engines, having received early interest from domestic and international buyers, Kundu told Inc42. The startup is building a vertically integrated aerospace manufacturing stack, bringing jet engines, avionics and airframe development under one roof. The company operates 87,000 sq ft R&D, assembly and testing facility in Bengaluru. Kundu told Inc42 that the startup has completed more than 100 ground-fire tests and is now moving towards flight testing. The startup expects its flight-testing programme to continue over the next year, following which its larger-thrust engines and transonic drone platforms could move towards commercial deployment.
paragraph3: “The startup currently generates revenue through the supply of small engines, while larger engine categories are undergoing further testing,” Kundu added. Green Aero has also developed its Blue Dragon engine core, which it claims is the first globally to demonstrate air-blast atomisers in the sub-kilonewton engine category. These atomisers are a form of fuel-injection technology generally used in larger jet engines. The startup said its engines can operate on diesel as well as jet fuel, allowing them to cater to different applications across military drones and aerospace platforms. Green Aero is now looking to develop engines in the four-kilonewton-plus category over the next three years, Kundu told Inc42. These larger engines are expected to power aircraft and drones capable of operating in the supersonic regime.
paragraph4: The startup is developing transonic drones powered by its existing sub-kilonewton engines, while its longer-term focus is on Collaborative Combat Aircraft (CCAs), autonomous aircraft designed to operate alongside manned fighter jets or independently. Kundu said the company is betting on the evolution of drone warfare towards faster, jet-powered and autonomous systems. The fundraise comes amid growing investor interest in India’s propulsion technology ecosystem, spanning missile engines, aircraft propulsion and satellite systems. D-Propulse, which is developing rotating detonation engines for high-speed drones and missiles, raised ₹25 Cr from IAN Alpha Fund earlier this year and is working towards flight-ready propulsion systems. The startup has also demonstrated a 5 kN air-breathing rotating detonation engine and plans flight tests in 2027. Meanwhile, Bellatrix Aerospace recently secured a multi-year contract from GalaxEye to supply propulsion systems for 30 satellites.
paragraph5: On the other hand, Manastu Space has raised ₹22 Cr in an ongoing funding round to develop satellite propulsion and debris-avoidance technology. While these startups are working across different propulsion applications, the growing funding and commercial contracts point to an emerging domestic ecosystem attempting to build critical aerospace hardware locally, reducing reliance on overseas suppliers.
