title: Flipkart CEO Ousted, PhonePe Revives IPO & More
title_bn: ফ্লিপকার্টের প্রধান নির্বাহী কর্মকর্তা বরখাস্ত, ফোনপে পুনরায় আইপিও চালু করেছে
author: TechPulse
excerpt: Leadership Crisis At Flipkart Kalyan Krishnamurthy’s decade-long stint as Flipkart group CEO has ended abruptly. Parent Walmart has asked him…
paragraph1: Leadership Crisis At Flipkart Kalyan Krishnamurthy’s decade-long stint as Flipkart group CEO has ended abruptly. Parent Walmart has asked him to step down amid a widening kickback probe and frustration over delayed IPO timelines and steep losses. What Led To The Ouster? An internal investigation has revealed that Flipkart executives allegedly took kickbacks worth ₹150 Cr from sellers to boost visibility and compromise the quality of materials for the company’s private-label business. Notably, this is the third such probe at Flipkart in less than three years. A previous probe had led to the exit of CFO Sriram Venkataraman in March this year under similar scrutiny. With Krishnamurthy gone, chief product and technology officer Balaji Thiagarajan is now stepping in as interim head till the company finds a new CEO. The IPO Question: Governance lapses were only half the story. Walmart executives were also peeved with Flipkart for repeatedly missing IPO deadlines and piling up losses – ₹8,468 Cr in FY26. The US-based retail giant is also unhappy with Flipkart’s capital-heavy expansions into peripheral verticals (like food delivery and microdramas) and sluggish growth during its recent Big Billion Days sale. That said, Walmart has now brought in McKinsey to assess IPO readiness and mandated EBITDA breakeven by March 2027. A Leadership Vacuum: Krishnamurthy’s departure marks Flipkart’s most consequential leadership reset since Walmart’s 2018 acquisition. This arrives just as the ecommerce giant navigates senior-level churn, disgruntled ex-employees demanding ESOPs and intensifying quick commerce wars. With its IPO now likely pushed to 2028, the new incoming CEO will have much to manage.
paragraph2: Flipkart’s Next Test: The ecommerce giant’s next chapter will depend on whether it can address the governance issues while delivering on Walmart’s profitability and IPO expectations. The company has the scale, the market presence and the resources, but it now needs the leadership and discipline to match. Can Flipkart clean up its house and still make it to the public markets? Let’s find out… From The Editor’s Desk 🔔 PhonePe Revives IPO Plans The fintech giant has restarted discussions with bankers for a planned listing by March 2027. It now plans to file its updated DRHP with SEBI by December-end for a $1.3 Bn OFS-only IPO, which will likely value PhonePe in the range of $12 Bn to $15 Bn. The rally in Indian equities and rising FPI inflows appear to have given PhonePe greater confidence to revive its IPO. This comes nearly a year after the decacorn filed its updated DRHP for an IPO, which then consisted solely of an OFS of 5.06 Cr shares. It later took a U-turn and deferred the issue, citing geopolitical uncertainty and volatility in global capital markets. 📈 PayU India Breaks Even Prosus-owned fintech company PayU India swung to the black and reported an adjusted EBITDA profit of $12 Mn in H1 FY27 compared to a loss of $1 Mn in the year-ago period. However, adjusted EBIT remained negative at $3 Mn. The bottom line improvements come despite a 3.3% YoY decline in its revenue to $384 Mn in the first half of FY27.
paragraph3: What helped offset the top line decline was growth in its lending business and transaction volumes. Separately, Prosus also disclosed that it recognised a $103 Mn impairment on a listed (equity-accounted) investment in its India ecosystem in H1 FY27. The Dutch investor attributed the loss to higher oil prices, elevated interest rates and a weaker Rupee. 💫 Jio Platforms Goes Cosmic The listed telecom giant has forayed into the online astrology market with the launch of JioAstro. Available in four languages, the new service uses AI models, trained in Vedic astrology, to offer personalised insights. With its spiritual tech platform, Jio is taking on the likes of consumer startups such as Astrotalk, AstroSage, AppsForBharat and VAMA. These new-age platforms have raised millions of dollars to offer everything, from online Pujas to virtual Darshans. This comes as the stars of the Indian digital astrology market are on the rise. The space is projected to become a $2.3 Bn opportunity by 2032, driven by AI-powered features, affordable data, convenience and vernacular offerings. 🤖 What’s Sarvam Really Mining? Earlier last week, the AI unicorn came under fire for hosting Chinese LLMs on its new inference platform. But the criticism hasn’t deterred Sarvam. The AI giant is doubling down on homegrown AI models, voice AI, document intelligence and agents.
paragraph4: This is part of Sarvam’s broader full-stack bet, under which it wants to offer Indian enterprises everything needed to build and deploy AI. The point is not that Sarvam has the best model for every task, but that it can provide several layers under one roof. This multi-product bet of the AI unicorn has also begun finding user traction. Tata Capital and Mahindra Finance have already deployed its voice agents across multiple functions, while Sarvam’s sovereignty pitch is bringing more enterprises to its fold. 💼 SoftBank India’s Top Exec Quits Narendra Rathi is stepping down from his role as an investment director at SoftBank Investment Advisers. His stint at the Japanese tech giant will come to an end by the end of this year. Rathi now plans to launch a public markets fund that will focus on India’s AI build-out. The new fund will likely focus on industrial companies, including smaller listed firms, which could benefit from the growing number of data centres in India. The departure comes amid a top-level churn in the Indian VC ecosystem. Earlier this month, Anup Gupta announced that he was quitting Nexus Venture Partners. Fireside Ventures’ cofounder Vinay Singh also resigned from his post weeks ago. Inc42 Markets RECOMMENDED FOR yOU Inc42 Startup Spotlight Building Skincare Around Absorption Active ingredients are the latest buzzword in the skincare industry. But the real challenge lies in getting these actives to the right layer of skin without losing potency. Permea is using pharma-inspired delivery systems to help these ingredients penetrate the skin more effectively.
paragraph5: A Differentiated Bet: Founded in 2025, Permea sells a range of skincare products, including cleansers, creams, serums and moisturisers. Its formulations use specialised encapsulation to protect active ingredients and help them travel deeper into the skin. The startup claims that its liposomal delivery can deliver up to 20X better penetration than non-encapsulated actives. Steady Market Traction: Permea, which currently only sells its products through its own website, claims to have already served 8,000 users so far. It now plans to expand to marketplaces like Nykaa and Purplle, while introducing more products to its range. The Road Ahead: The startup’s growth potential rests on whether its delivery technology can translate into visible, clinically meaningful results for consumers. Building trust will require robust efficacy data, consistent formulation quality and clear communication around what “better absorption” actually delivers. Nevertheless, the opportunity is significant: India’s skincare market is projected to become a $18.4 Bn opportunity by 2034. So, can Permea make actives more stable, targeted and effective? title_bn: ইউপিআই-র পরিকাঠামোর ওপর ঋণ দেওয়ার জন্য ১০ মিলিয়ন ডলার দেবে ভেগাপেই ব্যাগ
author: TechPulse
excerpt: Mumbai-based fintech startup Vegapay has raised $10 Mn (₹92.3 Cr) in a Series A funding round co-led by Vertex Ventures…
paragraph1: SUMMARYMumbai-based fintech startup Vegapay has raised $10 Mn (₹92.3 Cr) in a Series A funding round co-led by Vertex Ventures Southeast Asia and India and Prosus It will deploy the fresh capital to onboard more banks onto its credit line on UPI platform, introduce secured credit lines backed by fixed deposits, gold and mutual funds The funding round comprises both primary and secondary transactions, with over 40 employees getting an opportunity to sell a portion of their vested ESOPs Mumbai-based fintech startup Vegapay has raised $10 Mn (₹92.3 Cr) in a Series A funding round co-led by Vertex Ventures Southeast Asia and India and Prosus. The round also saw participation from existing investors Elevation Capital and Eximius Ventures.
paragraph2: The funding round comprises both primary and secondary transactions, with over 40 employees getting an opportunity to sell a portion of their vested employee stock ownership plans (ESOPs). It will deploy the fresh capital to onboard more banks onto its credit line on UPI platform, introduce secured credit lines backed by fixed deposits, gold and mutual funds, and expand its credit card, prepaid card and forex card programmes. It also plans to strengthen its engineering and risk teams. Founded in 2022 by Gaurav Mittal, Himanshu Agrawal and Puneet Sharma, Vegapay provides a technology platform that enables banks to launch and manage Credit Line on UPI (CLOU), credit card and other credit programmes.
paragraph3: Its platform allows banks to run multiple co-branded credit programmes, each with independent limits, pricing and rules. Banks can also deploy the technology on their own cloud infrastructure or on-premises. The startup claims to command a majority of India’s Credit Line on UPI market as of November 2026. Its platform is live with YES BANK, Unity Small Finance Bank, Suryoday Small Finance Bank and BOBCARD.
paragraph4: It also powers credit programmes for fintech and consumer-facing platforms, including Paytm, BharatPe, Kiwi UPI, Scapia and EbixCash World Money. Vegapay’s fundraise comes as Credit Line on UPI emerges as a new distribution channel for formal credit in India. The offering allows banks to provide customers with pre-sanctioned credit lines that can be used to make payments at UPI QR codes through existing payment applications, without requiring a separate credit card or app. While UPI has transformed India’s digital payments ecosystem, the integration of credit into the payment network could create another avenue for banks to distribute lending products.
paragraph5: Vegapay is positioning its platform as the underlying technology layer for banks looking to launch these products without building the entire infrastructure in-house. “UPI was India’s payments revolution. Credit Line on UPI is the UPI moment for credit, and banks should lead it,” said Gaurav Mittal, cofounder and CEO of Vegapay.

title: FCC says SpaceX can deploy 1 million satellites for data centers in space. Scientists are skeptical
title_bn: এফসিসি বলছে স্পেসএক্স মহাকাশে ডেটা সেন্টারের জন্য ১ মিলিয়ন স্যাটেলাইট স্থাপন করতে পারে। বিজ্ঞানীরা সংশয়ী।
author: TechPulse
excerpt: FCC says SpaceX can deploy 1 million satellites for data centers in space. Scientists are skeptical
paragraph1: The Trump administration on Wednesday gave SpaceX the green light to deploy 1 million satellites that it said would create data centers in space, a long-lofty goal of Elon Musk’s rocket company, in a move that has raised both skepticism and alarm among some scientists.The U.S. Federal Communications Commission lauded its authorization as a historic first amid the artificial intelligence race. It said that SpaceX's one million “orbital compute modules” (forming a data center constellation called “Starmind”) would process massive amounts of data that would be used back on Earth — and bring humans closer to harnessing “the full power of the sun.”“America is leading the world into the era of super intelligence," FCC Chairman Brendan Carr, who was appointed by Republican President Donald Trump, said in a statement.
paragraph2: He added that Wednesday's move “opens a bold new frontier.”A lengthier authorization order published by the FCC noted that the company must deploy at least “one authorized space station” by 2033 — and then gradually add more and more through 2040. Musk welcomed the decision over social media.The world's richest man has long vowed to form vast, solar-powered data centers in space to help run AI tools on Earth. But scientists and industry experts have stressed enormous technical and financial obstacles, as well as a host of environmental concerns.Adam Becker, an astrophysicist and author, called the prospect of launching a million satellites into space to create data centers “a fantasy."
paragraph3: “It’s not going to happen,” he said Wednesday.Proponents of data centers in space argue that capturing the sun’s energy would ease pressure on power grids and cut demand for sprawling computing warehouses on Earth (and resources like water needed to cool them). Space seems to offer a solution because it is cold, but it is also a vacuum, trapping heat inside objects much like a thermos. Becker explained that there are “basic physical limits” to otherwise radiating that heat out — and sending lots of smaller satellites could potentially carry the necessary material combined, but it would be expensive and difficult.He and others also point to additional risks, such as atmospheric pollution through launches and reentries, as well as possible in-orbit collisions that could impact other essential satellites.“You could end up with a cascading set of space junk collisions,” said Becker, noting such crashes could create “a cloud of debris” in the low Earth orbit — where many weather and telecommunication satellites are also found.
paragraph4: In its ruling, the FCC maintained that SpaceX's proposed Starmind constellation operates consistently with its orbital debris rules. It also acknowledged that it had received a “substantial number” of public comments leading up to its authorization Wednesday, including petitions to deny SpaceX's request. But the regulator maintained that deploying the satellites “serves the public interest” — and said that it dismissed topics that it didn't have authority over, such as environmental concerns.The American Astronomical Society, satellite communication company Viasat and Amazon-owned Kuiper Systems were among those who called on the regulator to deny SpaceX's proposed data centers in space.In a statement Wednesday, the AAS said it was “disheartened and dismayed” by the FCC's decision. The organization said that SpaceX's proposed position of data centers in low Earth orbit would undermine decades of federal investment in astronomical facilities and “the ability of astronomers and the public to enjoy and study the night sky.
paragraph5: ”“The proposed constellation involves larger (and therefore brighter) and more numerous objects," AAS said, noting that “these satellites would therefore be visible as extremely bright objects for longer periods in the night sky.”Becker echoed that sentiment. “It also is pollution of the night sky to the naked eye,” he said.Viasat, Amazon, SpaceX and the FCC did not immediately respond to The Associated Press’ requests for further comment Wednesday.
bangla_paragraph1: ট্রাম্প প্রশাসন বুধবার স্পেসএক্সকে ১ মিলিয়ন উপগ্রহ স্থাপন করার জন্য সবুজ আলো দিয়েছে যা বলেছিল যে এটি মহাকাশে ডেটা সেন্টার তৈরি করবে, ইলন মাস্কের রকেট সংস্থার একটি দীর্ঘ উচ্চ লক্ষ্য, এমন একটি পদক্ষেপে যা কিছু বিজ্ঞানীদের মধ্যে সংশয় ও উদ্বেগ উভয়ই উত্থাপন করেছে। মার্কিন ফেডারেল যোগাযোগ কমিশন কৃত্রিম বুদ্ধিমত্তার দৌড়ে এটির অনুমোদনকে একটি historicতিহাসিক প্রথম হিসাবে প্রশংসা করেছে। এটি বলেছে যে স্পেস এক্সের এক মিলিয়ন অর্বিটাল কম্পিউটিং মডিউল (একটি ডেটা কেন্দ্র নক্ষত্রমণ্ডল গঠন করে যা  নামে পরিচিত)
bangla_paragraph2: তিনি যোগ করেছেন যে বুধবারের পদক্ষেপটি একটি সাহসী নতুন সীমানা খুলে দেয়। এফসিসি দ্বারা প্রকাশিত একটি দীর্ঘতর অনুমোদনের আদেশে উল্লেখ করা হয়েছে যে কোম্পানিকে কমপক্ষে একটি অনুমোদিত মহাকাশ স্টেশন  2033 সালের মধ্যে স্থাপন করতে হবে এবং তারপরে ধীরে ধীরে 2040 সালের মধ্যে আরও বেশি যোগ করতে হবে। মাস্ক সামাজিক যোগাযোগ মাধ্যমে সিদ্ধান্তকে স্বাগত জানিয়েছেন। বিশ্বের সবচেয়ে ধনী ব্যক্তি দীর্ঘদিন ধরে মহাকাশে বিশাল, সৌর-চালিত ডেটা সেন্টার তৈরির প্রতিশ্রুতি দিয়েছেন যাতে পৃথিবীতে এআই সরঞ্জাম চালাতে সহায়তা করতে পারে। তবে বিজ্ঞানী এবং শিল্প বিশেষজ্ঞরা বিশাল প্রযুক্তিগত এবং আর্থিক বাধা জোর দিয়েছেন।
bangla_paragraph3: এটা ঘটতে যাচ্ছে না, তিনি বুধবার বলেন। মহাকাশে ডেটা সেন্টারগুলির সমর্থকরা যুক্তি দেন যে সূর্যের শক্তি ক্যাপচার করা বিদ্যুৎ গ্রিডের উপর চাপ হ্রাস করবে এবং পৃথিবীতে বিস্তৃত কম্পিউটিং গুদামগুলির চাহিদা হ্রাস পাবে (এবং তাদের শীতল করার জন্য প্রয়োজনীয় জলের মতো সম্পদ) । মহাকাশ একটি সমাধান প্রস্তাব করে বলে মনে হচ্ছে কারণ এটি ঠান্ডা, তবে এটি একটি শূন্যতাও, থার্মোসের মতো বস্তুগুলির ভিতরে তাপ আটকে রাখে। বেকার ব্যাখ্যা করেছিলেন যে অন্যথায় তাপকে বিকিরণ করতে এবং প্রচুর পরিমাণে প্রেরণ করতে মূল শারীরিক সীমাবদ্ধতা রয়েছে।
bangla_paragraph4: এফসিসি তার রায়ের মধ্যে বলেছিল যে স্পেসএক্সের প্রস্তাবিত স্টারমাইন্ড নক্ষত্রমণ্ডল তার কক্ষপথের ধ্বংসাবশেষের নিয়মের সাথে সামঞ্জস্যপূর্ণভাবে কাজ করে। এটি স্বীকার করেছে যে বুধবার এর অনুমোদনের আগে এটি একটি  উল্লেখযোগ্য সংখ্যক পাবলিক মন্তব্য পেয়েছে, যার মধ্যে স্পেস এক্সের অনুরোধ প্রত্যাখ্যান করার আবেদন রয়েছে। তবে নিয়ন্ত্রক বলেছিল ଯେ উপগ্রহ স্থাপন  জনস্বার্থে   এবং বলেছিল এটি পরিবেশগত উদ্বেগগুলির মতো কর্তৃত্ব নেই এমন বিষয়গুলিকে প্রত্যাখাত করেছে।
bangla_paragraph5: প্রস্তাবিত নক্ষত্রমণ্ডলে বৃহত্তর (এবং তাই উজ্জ্বল) এবং আরও অনেকগুলি বস্তু জড়িত রয়েছে", এএএস বলেছে, উল্লেখ করে যে এই উপগ্রহগুলি রাতে আকাশে দীর্ঘ সময়ের জন্য অত্যন্ত উজ্জল বস্তু হিসাবে দৃশ্যমান হবে।বেকার এই অনুভূতিটি পুনরাবৃত্তি করেছেন। এটি খালি চোখে রাতের আকাশের দূষণও, তিনি বলেছিলেন।ভিয়াসাট, অ্যামাজন, স্পেসএক্স এবং এফসিসি বুধবার আরও মন্তব্যের জন্য অ্যাসোসিয়েটেড প্রেসের অনুরোধে অবিলম্বে সাড়া দেয়নি।

paragraph1: Wednesday November 25, 2026 3:30 pm PST by Juli CloverA MacBook Air with a new look could launch in late 2027 or 2028, Bloomberg's Mark Gurman said in the latest episode of his Power On podcast. Apple plans to refresh the ‌MacBook Air‌ with M6 chips in early 2027 alongside the MacBook Neo 2, but that update won't include a new design. A more extensive overhaul could follow later in 2027 or in 2028, and the ‌MacBook Air‌ could get an OLED display at that time. MacBook Air is Apple's most popular computer, and they need to keep it very fresh. And so my anticipation is 2027, 2028 is when we're going to get the big MacBook Air overhaul.
paragraph2: And I think OLED will be part of that conversation. Apple last overhauled the ‌MacBook Air‌'s design in 2022, eliminating the prior wedge shape for a more uniform MacBook Pro-style chassis. The machine adopted a brighter Liquid Retina display with a notch for the camera, and a MagSafe charging port. In 2023, Apple added a 15-inch model, but since then, we've only gotten minor updates. Apple just added ‌OLED‌ to the MacBook Pro with the launch of the 2026 PROLED models, so it's not clear whether the high-end display will trickle down to the ‌MacBook Air‌ that quickly.
paragraph3: In prior reports, Gurman has leaned more toward the 2028 timeline than late 2027. Pricing on the PROLED ‌MacBook Pro‌ starts at $2,899, while the ‌MacBook Air‌ is one of Apple's more affordable notebooks and starts at $1,299. Apple would likely need to offer a high-end ‌OLED‌ ‌MacBook Air‌ alongside ‌MacBook Air‌ models with an LCD display to keep the price gap intact. title: IT Secy Defends Sarvam’s Token Factory Over Chinese LLM Debate
title_bn: আইটি সেকশন চীনের এলএলএম বিতর্কের বিষয়ে সারভাম টোকেন কারখানার প্রতিরক্ষা করেছে
author: TechPulse
excerpt: Reacting to the ongoing controversy around Sarvam AI hosting Chinese AI models on its new inference service Token Factory, MeitY…
paragraph1: SUMMARYKrishnan said that it was Sarvam’s imperative to monetise its offering, adding that the startup’s work on development of the indigenous AI model is different from its inference platform Critics have been raising questions over Token Factory hosting Chinese models despite Sarvam positioning itself as a champion of sovereign Indian AI Pushing back against the criticism, the AI unicorn said that the service relies on privately procured GPUs, adding that Token Factory will create a new commercial opportunity for the company Reacting to the ongoing controversy around Sarvam AI hosting Chinese AI models on its new inference service Token Factory, MeitY secretary S Krishnan has reportedly said that offering overseas LLMs does not constitute a violation of the principles of the IndiaAI Mission. “I don’t think there is any contradiction between what they (Sarvam) are doing for the IndiaAI mission and working towards the frontier model which will come in years and what they are offering now is a service in the AI space,” said Krishnan as per Business Standard. Defending Sarvam’s Token Factory, the MeitY secretary said that it was the company’s imperative to monetise its offering, adding that Sarvam’s work on development of the indigenous AI model is different from its inference platform. “After all, AI companies also require a revenue model.
paragraph2: They need a model in which they can monetise revenues and many other such experiments have been tried,” he reportedly said. As per news agency PTI, Krishnan also said that the government now also plans to work on a scheme to support AI inference. This comes a week after Sarvam debuted the Token Factory. The new offering lets enterprises access Indian and global AI models through a single API while running workloads on GPUs in India.
paragraph3: Besides Sarvam’s own 105B model, the platform also offers access to overseas open-weight models from Google, DeepSeek, GLM and Kimi. Quickly after the launch, critics raised questions over Token Factory hosting Chinese models despite Sarvam positioning itself as a champion of sovereign Indian AI. Many also raised questions over whether reliance on foreign open-weight models dilutes Sarvam’s push for homegrown AI capability. Pushing back against criticism, the AI unicorn said that the offering relies strictly on privately procured GPUs and not state-sponsored subsidies.
paragraph4: It also said that Token Factory will create a new commercial opportunity for the company, reduce latency and trim India’s dependence on overseas token platforms. To prove that inference hosting has not diluted its core research mission, Sarvam subsequently also rolled out its upgraded Sarvam-105B-1711 model and a dictation API for English and 22 other Indian languages. Addressing reporters on Wednesday, Krishnan also said that the ministry has also gathered feedback from startups and entities regarding Sarvam’s services. “I think based on what Sarvam has told us, based on the experience that people have, we do not see any misuse of the support which the India AI mission has provided to Sarvam in the service that they are now offering,” Krishnan reportedly added.
paragraph5: Going forward, Krishnan added that the government also plans to support the startup’s work towards a trillion-parameter model.
bangla_paragraph1: সারভামকে তার অফার থেকে অর্থ উপার্জন করা জরুরি বলে মন্তব্য করে শ্রী কৃষ্ণন বলেন, স্বদেশী এআই মডেলের উন্নয়নে স্টার্টআপের কাজ তার অনুমান প্ল্যাটফর্মের থেকে আলাদা সমালোচকরা টোকেন ফ্যাক্টরিতে চীনা মডেল হোস্টিং নিয়ে প্রশ্ন তুলেছেন।
bangla_paragraph2: তিনি বলেন, "এটি একটি নতুন মডেল, যা তাদের আয়কে মুনাফা করতে পারে এবং এর মতো আরও অনেক পরীক্ষা-নিরীক্ষা করা হয়েছে। সংবাদ সংস্থা পিটিআই অনুসারে, কৃষ্ণন আরও বলেছিলেন যে সরকার এখন এআই অনুমানকে সমর্থন করার জন্য একটি প্রকল্পে কাজ করার পরিকল্পনা করছে। এটি সরভমের টোকেন কারখানার আত্মপ্রকাশের এক সপ্তাহ পরে এসেছে। নতুন অফারটি ভারতে জিপিইউতে ওয়ার্কলোড চালানোর সময় একক এপিআইয়ের মাধ্যমে ভারতীয় এবং বৈশ্বিক এআই মডেলগুলিতে অ্যাক্সেস করতে দেয়।
bangla_paragraph3: সার্ভাম এর নিজস্ব 105B মডেল ছাড়াও প্ল্যাটফর্মটি গুগল, ডিপসিক, জিএলএম এবং কিমি থেকে বিদেশী ওপেন-ওয়েট মডেলগুলিতেও অ্যাক্সেস সরবরাহ করে। লঞ্চের পরে দ্রুত সমালোচকরা টোকেন ফ্যাক্টরিতে চীনা মডেল হোস্টিংয়ের বিষয়ে প্রশ্ন উত্থাপন করেছিলেন যদিও সার্ভম নিজেকে সার্বভৌম ভারতীয় এআইয়ের চ্যাম্পিয়ন হিসাবে অবস্থান করে। অনেকে বিদেশী খোলা-ওয়ের মডেলগুলির উপর নির্ভরশীলতা সার্ভামের দেশীয় এআই সক্ষমতার জন্য চাপকে পাতলা করে কিনা তা নিয়েও প্রশ্ন উত্সর্গ করেছিলেন। সমালোচনার বিরুদ্ধে চাপ দিয়ে এআই ইউনিকর্ন বলেছিল যে অফারটি পুনরায় চালু করা হবে।
bangla_paragraph4: এটি আরও বলেছে যে টোকেন কারখানাটি সংস্থার জন্য একটি নতুন বাণিজ্যিক সুযোগ তৈরি করবে, বিলম্ব হ্রাস করবে এবং বিদেশী টোকেন প্ল্যাটফর্মের উপর ভারতের নির্ভরতা হ্রাস পাবে। প্রমাণ করার জন্য যে অনুমান হোস্টিং তার মূল গবেষণা মিশনকে পাতলা করেনি, সর্বম পরে তার আপগ্রেড করা সর্বম -১০৫ বি -১৭১১ মডেল এবং ইংরেজি এবং ২২ টি অন্যান্য ভারতীয় ভাষার জন্য ডিক্টেশন এপিআই চালু করেছে। বুধবার সাংবাদিকদের উদ্দেশে শ্রী কৃষ্ণন আরও বলেন যে মন্ত্রক স্টার্টআপ এবং সংস্থাগুলির কাছ থেকে প্রতিক্রিয়াও সংগ্রহ করেছে।
bangla_paragraph5: ভবিষ্যতে, শ্রী কৃষ্ণন যোগ করেন যে, ট্রিলিয়ন প্যারামিটার মডেলের দিকে স্টার্টআপগুলির কাজকে সমর্থন করার পরিকল্পনা রয়েছে।

title: 1Password Security Breach: What Was Accessed and What Wasn't
title_bn: পাসওয়ার্ড সুরক্ষা লঙ্ঘনঃ কী কী অ্যাক্সেস করা হয়েছিল এবং কী কী ছিল না
author: TechPulse
excerpt: Popular password management app 1Password today said it experienced a security breach earlier this month. 1Password says some customer names and email addresses were accessed, but no customer vault contents were compromised. On November 19, 1Password
paragraph1: Wednesday November 25, 2026 1:09 pm PST by Juli CloverPopular password management app 1Password today said it experienced a security breach earlier this month. 1Password says some customer names and email addresses were accessed, but no customer vault contents were compromised. On November 19, 1Password saw indications that an employee's GitHub account had been breached and began investigating. The company says the breached GitHub account was used to access source code and push malicious code to backend services, with the code downloading some customer data. Here's a list of what the hacker was able to get: Names and email addresses customers use to sign into 1Password Account and user identifiers, and account creation and last sign-in times Public keys Secure Remote Password protocol parameters (1Password says this can't be used for account access) Tokens in emailed links for invitations, provisioning, and account recovery Other non-secret account data related to 1Password's internal architecture, like version numeric identifiers and file numeric identifiers 1Password source code, which 1Password says does not include customer data or user secrets Access to 1Password's CI/CD system, which it says has infrastructure-related secrets for the service to work According to 1Password, there is no impact to its services, availability, or product security. Customer vaults and the items in them were not accessed, nor were the keys that protect vaults. The hacker did not have access to account recovery keys or 1Password apps and browser extensions.
paragraph2: 1Password vaults are encrypted and protected by keys on the user end, so content is not accessible to 1Password or anyone who hacks the 1Password servers. The biggest risk comes from the token breach. Tokens can be used for account recovery, but they only work when paired with an SSO sign-in or a six-digit code sent to a user's email address. Codes have now been changed from six numeric digits to 10 alphanumeric characters to make them more difficult to brute force. The affected GitHub account has been disabled, and the attacker's token was revoked. Internal credentials that may have been exposed have been revoked. Internal GitHub, CI/CD, and endpoint controls have been "tightened," with new detection methods for similar attacks.
paragraph3: The company found no internal evidence of user account takeovers or compromise using the exposed account provisioning tokens, and it has hired independent cybersecurity experts to validate its response. 1Password users who had a token accessed were notified, but it is unclear if 1Password has sent notices about the breach to all users. While the blog post is titled as "update on" a security incident, it does not seem that the breach was disclosed when 1Password first learned of it six days ago. 1Password will not contact users to ask for an account password or Secret Key, and the information should be entered only in the official 1Password app or official website. It recommends all users be cautious about phishing attempts like emails, texts, and calls that mention 1Password or account recovery. Users do not need to update or change anything in their 1Password accounts. paragraph1: Wednesday November 25, 2026 12:38 pm PST by Juli CloverPopular messaging app WhatsApp was today updated with an option to schedule messages, which the company says was one of its most requested features. WhatsApp users can create a message and schedule it to arrive from 10 minutes to 14 days later in one-to-one chats and group chats. Scheduling a message can be done by pressing and holding the send button after composing and then choosing a date and time. Scheduled messages work with text, photos, and videos, and will still send even if a user's device is offline.
paragraph2: There is an option to see all scheduled messages and delete them before they're sent if needed. Scheduled messages are end-to-end encrypted and look like any other WhatsApp message, with no indication on the receiver's end that the message was scheduled. Apple's iMessage service already has a Send Later feature that supports scheduling messages, so WhatsApp is catching up with Apple's built-in messaging option. WhatsApp says scheduled messages are rolling out globally over the coming weeks.

title: Save on a budget router with prices starting at just $39 — TP-Link Archer AX1450 and Netgear RAX5 Wi-Fi 6 routers go on low sale
title_bn: মাত্র ৩৯ ডলার থেকে শুরু হওয়া বাজেট রাউটারে সঞ্চয় করুন  টিপি-লিঙ্ক আর্চার এএক্স ১৪৫০ এবং নেটজিয়ার আরএক্স ৫ ওয়াই-ফাই ৬ রাউটার কম দামে বিক্রি হচ্ছে
author: TechPulse
excerpt: The TP-Link Archer AX1450 is available for just $39
paragraph1: (Image credit: TP-Link) Suppose you don’t need the extra speed and capacity that Wi-Fi 7 offers, and you just want something cheap to give you decent coverage throughout your house? Well, that’s where something like the TP-Link Archer AX1450 comes into focus. Walmart has the router on sale this week for $39, a $10 discount off its regular asking price.
paragraph2: The Archer AX1450 is by no means a speed demon, delivering up to 250 Mbps over the 2.4 GHz band and up to 1,201 Mbps on the 5 GHz band. That should be more than sufficient if you have a 1 Gbps or lower broadband connection.
paragraph3: You get one GbE WAN port and four GbE LAN ports for connecting your wired devices. The router features four antennas and four wireless streams. Stay On the Cutting Edge: Get the Tom's Hardware Newsletter Get Tom's Hardware's best news and in-depth reviews, straight to your inbox.
paragraph4: Brandon Hill is a senior editor at Tom's Hardware. He has written about PC and Mac tech since the late 1990s with bylines at AnandTech, DailyTech, and Hot Hardware. When he is not consuming copious amounts of tech news, he can be found enjoying the NC mountains or the beach with his wife and two sons.
bangla_paragraph1: (ছবি ক্রেডিটঃ টিপি-লিঙ্ক) ধরুন আপনার অতিরিক্ত গতি এবং ক্ষমতা প্রয়োজন নেই যা ওয়াই-ফাই ৭ সরবরাহ করে, এবং আপনি কেবল আপনার বাড়িতে একটি শালীন কভারেজ দেওয়ার জন্য সস্তা কিছু চান? ঠিক আছে, সেখানেই টিপি লিঙ্ক আর্চার এএক্স১৪৫০ এর মতো কিছু ফোকাস আসে। ওয়ালমার্টের এই সপ্তাহে রাউটারটি বিক্রি হচ্ছে ৩৯ ডলারে, এর স্বাভাবিক জিজ্ঞাসা মূল্যের তুলনায় ১০ ডলার ছাড়।
bangla_paragraph2: আর্চার এএক্স১৪৫০ কোনোভাবেই গতির দানব নয়, ২.৪ গিগাহার্টজ ব্যান্ডে ২৫০ এমবিপিএস এবং ৫ গিগহার্টজ ব্যাণ্ডে ১,২০১ এমবিপিক্স পর্যন্ত সরবরাহ করে। আপনার যদি ১ গিগাবাইটস বা তার কম ব্রডব্যান্ড সংযোগ থাকে তবে এটি যথেষ্ট হবে।
bangla_paragraph3: আপনি আপনার তারযুক্ত ডিভাইসগুলি সংযুক্ত করার জন্য একটি গিগাবাইট ওয়ান পোর্ট এবং চারটি গিগবাইট ল্যান পোর্টের সুবিধা পাবেন। রাউটারটিতে চারটি অ্যান্টেনা এবং চার টি ওয়্যারলেস স্ট্রিম রয়েছে। কাটিং এজ এ থাকুনঃ টম হার্ডওয়্যার নিউজলেটার পান আপনার ইনবক্সে সরাসরি টম'স হার্ডওয়ারের সেরা সংবাদ এবং গভীর পর্যালোচনা পান।
bangla_paragraph4: ব্র্যান্ডন হিল টম হার্ডওয়্যারের সিনিয়র সম্পাদক। তিনি ১৯৯০ এর দশকের শেষের দিক থেকে আনন্দটেক, ডেইলিটেক এবং হট হার্ডওয়ারে বাইলাইন দিয়ে পিসি এবং ম্যাক প্রযুক্তি সম্পর্কে লিখেছেন। যখন তিনি প্রচুর পরিমাণে প্রযুক্তিগত সংবাদ গ্রহণ করছেন না, তখন তাকে তার স্ত্রী এবং দুই ছেলের সাথে এনসি পর্বতমালা বা সৈকতের উপভোগ করতে পাওয়া যায়।

title: HONOR Magic 9 Pro Max debuts in Malaysia with dual 200MP cameras and cinematic ARRI video technology
title_bn: HONOR Magic 9 Pro Max মালয়েশিয়ায় ২০০ মেগাপিক্সেলের ডুয়াল ক্যামেরা এবং সিনেমাটিক ARRI ভিডিও প্রযুক্তির সাথে আত্মপ্রকাশ করেছে
author: TechPulse
excerpt: The HONOR Magic 9 Pro Max is positioned as a flagship device targeting photography enthusiasts and content creators, with the company highlighting its low-light imaging capabilities, advanced stabilisation, professional colour processing and video re
paragraph1: HONOR has launched the Magic 9 Pro Max in Malaysia, expanding the availability of its camera-focused flagship smartphone following its September debut in China. The smartphone combines dual 200MP cameras, professional-grade video technology developed in collaboration with ARRI, a high-brightness display, a large silicon-carbon battery and AI-powered features.The HONOR Magic 9 Pro Max also introduces enhanced connectivity with Apple devices, including iPhone, Apple Watch and Mac, alongside advanced audio capabilities, durability certifications and a range of display technologies focused on eye comfort.Here is a look at the key features and specifications of the HONOR Magic 9 Pro Max.HONOR Magic 9 Pro Max camera: Dual 200MP sensors and 50MP ultra-wide cameraThe HONOR Magic 9 Pro Max features a dual 200MP camera setup, comprising an Ultra Night Main Camera and an Ultra Night Telephoto Camera, designed to capture detailed images in different lighting conditions.The 200MP main camera features a 1/1.28-inch sensor, an f/1.57 aperture and gimbal-level 3-degree stabilisation. HONOR claims it offers industry-first CIPA 8.05 stabilisation performance.The 200MP Ultra Night Telephoto Camera features a 1/1.4-inch sensor, an f/2.
paragraph2: 6 aperture and CIPA 8.05 stabilisation, while the 50MP ultra-wide camera comes with an f/2.0 aperture.The smartphone also features a 55MP square-format front camera, designed to provide greater flexibility while framing selfies, portraits and group shots.ARRI LogC3 video and 87 professional ARRI LooksHONOR has partnered with ARRI to bring its imaging science to the Magic 9 Pro Max, including an ARRI LogC3 video pipeline. The technology is designed to deliver smoother colour transitions, softer highlights and more nuanced shadows.The smartphone includes 87 official ARRI Looks, allowing users to apply cinematic colour profiles to their footage. The company says the feature is aimed at users looking for professional-style colour grading and creative video output directly from a smartphone.The device also supports cinematic video recording in a 2.39:1 ultrawide aspect ratio and 4K Live Photos, recording three seconds of footage with every shutter press.20-metre cinematic directional microphoneThe HONOR Magic 9 Pro Max features a Cinematic Directional Microphone that can capture sound from distances of up to 20 metres, according to the company.The microphone is designed to record distant subjects as well as quieter, nearby sounds, offering greater flexibility for video recording, interviews and other content creation scenarios.
paragraph3: HONOR Imaging Chip H1 and RAW-domain noise reductionThe Magic 9 Pro Max is powered by the HONOR Imaging Chip H1, built on a 6nm process and delivering 18.8 TOPS/W energy efficiency, according to the company.The imaging chip uses RAW-domain noise reduction technology, which HONOR claims helps retain original image details while reducing noise, particularly when capturing photographs in challenging lighting conditions.Turret-inspired camera design and anti-reflective coatingThe smartphone features a three-lens turret-inspired camera module influenced by professional cinema cameras. HONOR says the module combines a metal unibody design with precision assembly.The camera lenses are engineered with a 5,600-layer high-precision silicon nitride coating, which reportedly reduces reflections to as low as 1.5%, helping improve optical performance.6.8-inch display with 10,000-nit peak brightnessThe HONOR Magic 9 Pro Max features a 6.8-inch display with a peak brightness of 10,000 nits. The panel offers 6,000 nits of peak brightness at 20% APL and a minimum brightness of 1 nit.The display supports an adaptive refresh rate ranging from 1Hz to 120Hz, balancing smooth scrolling, gaming and power efficiency.
paragraph4: Nine AI eye-care technologies and TÜV Rheinland certificationHONOR has incorporated nine eye-care technologies, including chip-level AI defocus eye comfort, Circular Polarized Display 2.0, dynamic dimming, AI Circadian Night Display, 4320Hz PWM dimming, Natural Tone Display, Motion Sickness Relief Display, hardware-level low blue light and Personalized Display 2.0.The company claims these technologies help reduce visual fatigue, improve viewing comfort and support healthier display usage. The display has also received TÜV Rheinland Full Care Display 6.0 certification, according to HONOR.Snapdragon 2nm chipset and 8,000mAh batteryThe Magic 9 Pro Max is powered by the Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6 processor, which HONOR says is built on a 2nm process.The smartphone packs an 8,000mAh silicon-carbon battery, designed to offer extended usage. It also features the HONOR RF Enhanced Chip C3 for improved connectivity and signal performance.Dual AI surround subwoofers and spatial audioThe device features dual 1216 HONOR AI Surround Subwoofers supported by an AI spatial soundstage algorithm. The audio system incorporates an 8cc acoustic cavity and 0.88mm amplitude, according to HONOR.
paragraph5: The company claims the smartphone has received SGS 5-Star Directional High-Sensitivity Sound Acquisition Certification and SGS Spatial Audio Certification.Water and dust resistanceThe HONOR Magic 9 Pro Max carries IP68, IP69 and IP69K ratings for dust and water resistance. These certifications cover protection against immersion and exposure to high-temperature and high-pressure water jets under specified testing conditions.Apple ecosystem integration with iPhone, Apple Watch and MacHONOR has introduced cross-device features designed to improve interoperability with Apple products.The smartphone supports two-way notification mirroring between HONOR phones and iPhones, allowing users to respond to messages received on their HONOR device directly from an iPhone.It also supports Apple Watch integration, enabling the mirroring of incoming calls, messages and health and fitness data to the HONOR phone.Users can transfer footage from the Magic 9 Pro Max to a Mac with a single tap and browse or organise photos and videos on the computer.AI Key and Highlight Clip CaptureThe HONOR Magic 9 Pro Max features a dedicated AI key supporting Highlight Clip Capture. The feature can identify video highlights and offers tools such as subtitle collages, video clipping and video-to-Live Photo conversion, simplifying content editing and sharing.
bangla_paragraph1: HONOR মালয়েশিয়ায় ম্যাজিক 9 প্রো ম্যাক্স চালু করেছে, চীনে সেপ্টেম্বরে আত্মপ্রকাশের পর ক্যামেরা-ফোকাসযুক্ত ফ্ল্যাগশিপ স্মার্টফোনটির প্রাপ্যতা প্রসারিত করেছে। স্মার্টফোনে আইফোন, অ্যাপল ওয়াচ এবং ম্যাক সহ অ্যাপল ডিভাইসের সাথে উন্নত সংযোগের পাশাপাশি ডুয়াল 200 এমপি ক্যামেরা, এআরআরআই-র সাথে সহযোগিতায় উন্নত পেশাদার-গ্রেড ভিডিও প্রযুক্তি, একটি উচ্চ উজ্জ্বলতা প্রদর্শন, একটি বড় সিলিকন-কার্বন ব্যাটারি এবং এআই-চালিত বৈশিষ্ট্যগুলি একত্রিত করা হয়েছে।
bangla_paragraph2: এই স্মার্টফোনটিতে একটি 55 এমপি স্কয়ার ফর্ম্যাট ফ্রন্ট ক্যামেরা রয়েছে, যা সেলফি, প্রতিকৃতি এবং গ্রুপ শট ফ্রেম করার সময় আরও নমনীয়তা সরবরাহ করার জন্য ডিজাইন করা হয়েছে। এআরআরআই লোগসি 3 ভিডিও এবং 87 পেশাদার এআরআই লুকসহোনর এর সাথে অংশীদার হয়েছে।
bangla_paragraph3: HONOR ইমেজিং চিপ H1 এবং RAW-ডোমেন গোলমাল হ্রাসThe Magic 9 Pro Max হল HONor ইমেজের চিপ এইচ1 দ্বারা চালিত, যা 6nm প্রক্রিয়ায় নির্মিত এবং 18.8 TOPS / W শক্তি দক্ষতা প্রদান করে। ইমেজার চিপটি RAW ডোমেন শব্দ হ্রাস প্রযুক্তি ব্যবহার করে, যা HONOr দাবি করে যে এটি গোলমালা হ্রাস করার সময় মূল চিত্রের বিবরণগুলি ধরে রাখতে সহায়তা করে, বিশেষত চ্যালেঞ্জিং আলোর অবস্থার মধ্যে ফটোগ্রাফ ক্যাপচার করার সময়।
bangla_paragraph4: নয়টি এআই চোখের যত্ন প্রযুক্তি এবং টিইউভি রেইনল্যান্ড শংসাপত্রHONOR নয়টি চোখের স্বাস্থ্য প্রযুক্তি অন্তর্ভুক্ত করেছে, চিপ-স্তরের এআই ডিফোকাস চোখের আরাম, সার্কুলার পোলারিজড ডিসপ্লে ২.০, গতিশীল ডিমিং, এআই সার্কাডিয়ান নাইট ডিসপোলে, ৪৩২০ হার্জ পিডব্লিউএম ডিমਿੰਗ, প্রাকৃতিক টোন ডিসফ্লে, মোশন সিক্নি রিলিফ ডিসসপ্লের, হার্ডওয়্যার-স্তর কম নীল আলো এবং ব্যক্তিগতকৃত ডিসচপ্লে 2.0. কোম্পানি দাবি করে যে এই প্রযুক্তিগুলি দৃষ্টি ক্লান্তি হ্রাস করতে, দেখার আরাম উন্নত করতে এবং স্বাস্থ্যকর ডিসಪ್লে ব্যবহারকে সমর্থন করে।
bangla_paragraph5: কোম্পানি দাবি করে যে স্মার্টফোনটি এসজিএস 5-স্টার ডিরেকশনাল হাই-সেনসিটিভিটি সাউন্ড অ্যাক্সিসিশন সার্টিফিকেশন এবং এসজিএসের স্প্যাটিয়াল অডিও সার্টিফিকেশন পেয়েছে। জল এবং ধুলো প্রতিরোধের জন্য HONOR Magic 9 Pro Max IP68, IP69 এবং IP69K রেটিং ধুলো এবং জলের প্রতিরোধ ক্ষমতা বহন করে। এই সার্টিসিফিকেশনের মধ্যে নিমজ্জন এবং নির্দিষ্ট পরীক্ষার শর্তে উচ্চ তাপমাত্রা এবং উচ্চ চাপের জল জেটের সংস্পর্শে সুরক্ষা অন্তর্ভুক্ত রয়েছে। আইফোন, অ্যাপল ওয়াচ এবং ম্যাকহোনরের সাথে অ্যাপল বাস্তুতন্ত্রের সংহতকরণ ইন্টিটিউটেড।

paragraph2: Thankfully, T-Mobile's new structure still allows for other deal options as well. title: Motorola Edge 70 Neo vs Vivo S2 vs Nothing Phone 4a: Which offers more for  ₹40,000?
title_bn: মটোরোলা এজ ৭০ নিও বনাম ভিভো এস২ বনাম নিথ ফোন ৪এ: ৪০,০০০ টাকায় কোন ফোন বেশি দাম দিচ্ছে?
author: TechPulse
excerpt: Motorola Edge 70 Neo takes on Vivo S2 and Nothing Phone 4a in India. Compare their prices, processors, displays, batteries and cameras.
paragraph1: The sub- ₹40,000 smartphone market in India has a new contender, with Motorola introducing the Edge 70 Neo in its premium mid-range Edge series. The new handset enters a segment that already includes the Vivo S2 and Nothing Phone 4a, offering buyers several choices across display quality, camera performance, battery life and processing power.While Motorola is banking on a large battery and a high-refresh-rate display, Vivo is offering a similarly sized battery, while Nothing stands out with a triple rear camera system and its signature Glyph lighting. Here is how the three smartphones compare on price and specifications. Motorola Edge 70 Neo vs Vivo S2 vs Nothing Phone 4a: Price in India The Motorola Edge 70 Neo has been launched in a single 8GB RAM and 128GB storage variant, priced at ₹40,999. However, introductory bank cashback offers bring its effective price down to ₹34,999.The phone is available in four colour options: Mountain View, Gray Lilac, Milky Blue and Sage.The Vivo S2 starts at ₹42,999 for the 8GB RAM and 128GB storage variant. Meanwhile, the Nothing Phone 4a is listed at ₹39,999 for its 6GB RAM and 128GB storage version on Flipkart. Display: Which phone offers the better screen? Motorola Edge 70 Neo features a 6.8-inch 1.5K quad-curved AMOLED display with a 144Hz refresh rate and peak brightness of 5,200 nits.The Vivo S2 also gets a 6.8-inch 1.5K AMOLED screen, but its refresh rate is capped at 120Hz and peak brightness at 3,000 nits.
paragraph2: Nothing Phone 4a comes with a slightly smaller 6.78-inch 1.5K AMOLED display. It supports a 120Hz refresh rate and offers peak brightness of up to 4,500 nits. Processor and software: Motorola vs Vivo vs Nothing The three smartphones use different processors and software interfaces.The Motorola Edge 70 Neo is powered by Qualcomm's Snapdragon 7s Gen 3 chipset and runs on Android 16 with Motorola's Hello UX interface.The Vivo S2 uses a MediaTek Dimensity 7360 Turbo processor and runs OriginOS 6.Nothing Phone 4a, meanwhile, is powered by Qualcomm's Snapdragon 7s Gen 4 chipset and comes with Nothing OS 4.1.All three devices run Android 16 out of the box. Battery and charging: Which smartphone lasts longer? Battery capacity is one of the key differences between the three devices.The Motorola Edge 70 Neo packs a 7,000mAh battery with support for 45W wired charging and 7.5W reverse wired charging. It also carries an IP64 rating for dust and water resistance.The Vivo S2 comes with a slightly larger 7,050mAh battery, although its wired charging support is limited to 44W.
paragraph3: Nothing Phone 4a has a smaller 5,400mAh battery but supports faster 50W wired charging. It also offers 7.5W reverse wired charging. Camera: Nothing Phone 4a gets a triple rear setup The Motorola Edge 70 Neo features a dual rear camera system comprising a 50MP primary sensor with optical image stabilisation (OIS) and a 2MP macro camera. For selfies, it gets a 32MP front camera.The Vivo S2 also offers a 50MP primary rear camera paired with a 2MP secondary sensor. It has a 32MP front-facing camera for selfies and video calls.Nothing Phone 4a takes a different approach with three rear cameras. Its setup includes a 50MP OIS primary sensor, an 8MP ultra-wide camera and a 50MP telephoto lens with 3.5x optical zoom. It also gets a 32MP selfie camera.Another distinguishing feature is Nothing's Glyph lighting system on the rear panel.pecificationsMotorola Edge 70 NeoVivo S2Nothing Phone 4aDisplay6.8-inch AMOLED, 144Hz6.8-inch AMOLED, 120Hz6.78-inch AMOLED, 120HzProcessorSnapdragon 7s Gen 3Dimensity 7360 TurboSnapdragon 7s Gen 4Rear camera50MP + 2MP50MP + 2MP50MP + 8MP + 50MPFront camera32MP32MP32MPBattery7,000mAh7,050mAh5,400mAhCharging45W44W50WStarting price ₹40,999 ₹42,999 ₹39,999With the three phones competing in a similar price segment, buyers can compare their display, battery, processor and camera features before making a choice.

bangla_paragraph1: ভারতে ৪০,০০০ টাকার নিচে স্মার্টফোনের বাজারে একটি নতুন প্রতিদ্বন্দ্বী রয়েছে, মটোরোলা তার প্রিমিয়াম মিড-রেঞ্জের এজ সিরিজে এজ 70 নিও চালু করেছে। নতুন হ্যান্ডসেটটি এমন একটি বিভাগে প্রবেশ করে যার মধ্যে ইতিমধ্যে ভিভো এস 2 এবং নিথি ফোন 4 এ অন্তর্ভুক্ত রয়েছে, যা ক্রেতাদের ডিসপ্লে মান, ক্যামেরার পারফরম্যান্স, ব্যাটারির জীবন এবং প্রসেসিং পাওয়ার জুড়ে বেশ কয়েকটি পছন্দ সরবরাহ করে।

bangla_paragraph3: নট ফোন ৪এ এর ছোট ৫,৪০০ এমএএইচ ব্যাটারি রয়েছে তবে এটি দ্রুত 50W তারযুক্ত চার্জিং সমর্থন করে। এটি 7.5W বিপরীত তারযুক্ত শার্জও সরবরাহ করে। ক্যামেরাঃ নটফোন 4 এ একটি ট্রিপল রিয়ার সেটআপ পায়। মটোরোলা এজ 70 নিওতে একটি দ্বৈত রিয়ার ক্যামেরা সিস্টেম রয়েছে যা একটি 50 এমপি প্রাথমিক সেন্সরকে অপটিক্যাল ইমেজ স্ট্যাবিলাইজেশন (ওআইএস) এবং একটি 2 এমপি ম্যাক্রো ক্যামেরা নিয়ে গঠিত। সেলফিগুলির জন্য, এটি একটি 32 এমপি ফ্রন্ট ক্যামেরা পায়। ভিভো এস 2 এছাড়াও একটি 2 মেগাপিক্সেল সেকেন্ডারি সেন্সরের সাথে যুক্ত একটি 50 মেগাবিক্সেল প্রাইমারি রিয়ার ক্যামেরা সরবরাহ করে । এটিতে 32 এম পি ফ্রন্ট-ফেস ক্যামেরা রয়েছে

title: Navi Crosses 5% UPI Market Share As PhonePe, Google Pay Slip In October
title_bn: নবির ইউপিআই মার্কেট শেয়ার ৫ শতাংশ ছাড়িয়েছে
author: TechPulse
excerpt: Sachin Bansal-led Navi continued to strengthen its position in the UPI ecosystem in October 2026. The fintech platform’s share in…
paragraph1: SUMMARYNavi's UPI transaction share rose to 5.04% in October from 4.76% in September PhonePe, Google Pay and Paytm recorded marginal declines in their UPI market shares Navi overtook CRED in UPI transaction value, processing ₹62,492 Cr in October Sachin Bansal-led Navi continued to strengthen its position in the UPI ecosystem in October 2026. The fintech platform’s share in the UPI market crossed the 5% mark over the past month, data released by NPCI revealed. Of the 25.47 Bn processed by UPI, transactions processed by Navi platform rose to 5.04% from 4.76% in September. Overall, Navi hosted 1.
paragraph2: 27 Bn UPI transactions during the month, an 11% increase from 1.14 Bn in September The fintech platform processed around 1.27 Bn UPI transactions during the month, up from 1.14 Bn in September. Navi’s gains came as the UPI leaders — PhonePe, Google Pay and Paytm — continued to see some decline in their market share in October. Taken together, the three platforms still combine over 85% of India’s UPI market. PhonePe remained the largest UPI app, with a 45.34% share of transaction volume, down from 45.57% in September.
paragraph3: Google Pay’s share fell to 32.09% from 32.23%, while Paytm’s share declined to 7.96% from 8.12%. Navi Overtakes CRED In UPI Transaction Value Navi’s growth was also visible in transaction value. The platform processed UPI transactions worth ₹62,492 Cr in October, marginally ahead of CRED’s ₹62,102 Cr, according to NPCI data. This made Navi the fourth-largest UPI app by transaction value, ending CRED’s position in the ranking after more than five years. Among other emerging platforms, WhatsApp’s share increased to 0.
paragraph4: 85% in October from 0.80% in September. FamApp by Trio also recorded a rise to 0.99% from 0.95%, while BHIM’s share edged up to 1.07% from 1.06%. On the other hand, super.money’s share declined to 1.
paragraph5: 65% from 1.69%. CRED maintained its share at 0.59%, while Amazon Pay’s share increased marginally to 0.40% from 0.38%. The data indicates that while PhonePe and Google Pay continue to control a large part of India’s UPI market, smaller players such as Navi are gradually expanding their presence. Navi’s latest gains also come amid growing competition among fintech platforms to capture a larger share of India’s digital payments market.

title: Beyond Its Sovereignty Bet, What’s Sarvam Really Mining?
title_bn: সার্বভৌমত্বের বাইরেও সারভাম আসলে কী খুঁজছে?
author: TechPulse
excerpt: Last week, Sarvam AI found itself in the eye of a storm. The poster child of India’s sovereign AI ambitions…
paragraph1: SUMMARYSarvam AI has expanded its product portfolio with an upgraded 105B large language model and Dictate, a speech-to-text API supporting English and 22 Indian languages Beyond building sovereign AI models, Sarvam is looking to become a one-stop shop for enterprise AI in India, offering everything from foundation models and inference infrastructure to AI-powered applications While its upgraded 105B model narrows the performance gap with global peers on conversational tasks, its voice AI business is already finding commercial traction, clocking over 3 Mn minutes a day and a billion-plus API calls a month, according to the company Last week, Sarvam AI found itself in the eye of a storm. The poster child of India’s sovereign AI ambitions drew flak for offering access to Chinese AI models, including DeepSeek, Kimi and GLM, through its newly launched inference platform, Token Factory. The point of contention among critics has been whether a startup that received government support to build indigenous AI models should be in the business of selling access to Chinese models. Sarvam clarified that its Token Factory runs on privately procured GPUs, and its inference business does not dilute the ambition to build homegrown AI models. Amid this controversy, the AI unicorn has expanded its product portfolio with two new launches — Sarvam-105B-1711, an upgraded version of its existing large language model (LLM), and Sarvam Dictate, a speech-to-text API that supports English and 22 Indian languages. The launches offer a glimpse into Sarvam’s larger game plan. The unicorn wants to offer Indian enterprises everything they need to build and deploy AI. From homegrown AI models and the infrastructure to run them to voice AI, coding agents and workplace applications, Sarvam desires to become a one-stop shop for enterprise AI in India. Not to mention, Sarvam’s full-stack AI ambition has begun to find commercial traction, particularly in the financial services sector, including Tata Capital and Mahindra Finance. The latter has also deployed Sarvam-powered voice agents across sales, collections and frontline employee engagement. It claims to have executed 1 Cr+ customer calls via its voice stack. At Bolna’s Symphony 2026 last week, Vivek Raghavan, the cofounder of Sarvam AI, claimed that the company was clocking more than 3 Mn minutes a day and had crossed a billion API calls a month for its voice AI business. At its flagship AI event, Epoch, in July this year, Sarvam unveiled a stack spanning foundation models, inference, coding, voice, document intelligence and workplace agents. Its voice agents had already handled 325 Mn minutes of conversations, while its Indus platform brought together voice, work, document, content and coding agents.
paragraph2: So, how do the pieces of Sarvam’s existing strategy fit together? Sarvam Punches Above Its Weight Sarvam-105B-1711 is not a completely new model. It is a post-trained checkpoint of the existing 105B, with Sarvam using its upgraded Blackwell infrastructure and reinforcement-learning stack to improve performance on specific workloads. According to Ankit Jha, a machine learning engineer at Warner Bros. Discovery, post-training allows a company to improve its existing model for particular use cases or edge cases. It is also a common industry practice, with major labs routinely improving existing checkpoints rather than training an entirely new model from scratch. In Sarvam’s case, the original 105B was trained on H100 GPUs, while the post-training runs were carried out on newer Blackwell infrastructure. Jha said Sarvam’s investment in its own technology for training, running and compressing AI models has helped it improve its reinforcement learning capabilities. The results are worth looking at. According to Sarvam, its average score across eight conversational-agent benchmarks has grown from 42.6 to 73.9. Its Indic suite score reached 79.1, while the model also posted 89.
paragraph3: 7 on AIME 26 and 80.4 on GPQA Diamond. On the conversational-agent benchmark average, Sarvam puts the model at 73.9 against 74.0 for Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite. RECOMMENDED FOR yOU The significance is not that Sarvam has suddenly overtaken the major global labs. Some of its numbers remain behind larger frontier models on reasoning, coding and knowledge benchmarks. What has changed is the distance between Sarvam and the efficient tier of open models, particularly for workloads where deployment cost, Indian languages and data control matter. Jha said that the model could be a strong option for organisations that want to run AI with less than 100 GB of VRAM. Its roughly 65 GB quantised version can fit into the memory of a high-end workstation-class GPU, opening up a local-AI route that is difficult with much larger models. This is crucial for Indian banks and corporates that may not want sensitive workloads to leave their environments. The engineering underneath the model is just as important. According to Sarvam, its B200 training setup doubled pretraining throughput from 5,500 to 10,900 tokens per second per GPU, while reinforcement-learning steps fell from about 13 minutes to seven.
paragraph4: Its 4-bit version can generate around 6,000 tokens per second per B200 across 64 concurrent users. The Expanding Application Layer Sarvam is not just building the brains behind AI but also the tools that put them to work. Dictate is a clear example. The API turns speech into the text a speaker intended to write, rather than simply transcribing every word literally. It supports English and 22 Indian languages and requires 40% fewer character edits than Gemini 3.5 Transcribe in English and 47% fewer in Indian languages and Hinglish. Kivi, Sarvam’s voice-based desktop application, lets users dictate across applications on Mac and is positioned as an alternative to products such as Wispr Flow. Kivi also understands more than 22 Indian languages, including code-switching, while its Epoch roadmap lists Android among the next platforms. Kivi and Dictate sit at different points in the same stack. Kivi is the end-user application, while Dictate turns the underlying speech and language capabilities into an API that developers can embed into their products. Sarvam also offers a document-intelligence API, Extract. It pulls structured information from documents so developers can route it into their own products. With Extract, Dictate and Kivi, the company has extended its playbook to include voice and documents. Finding The Next Thing Sarvam has also raised substantial capital to pursue its full-stack ambition.
paragraph5: Its $234 Mn Series B, led by HCLTech at a $1.5 Bn valuation, gives it the financial firepower to build models, infrastructure and enterprise products at the same time. It is also building for enterprises that care about where their AI runs. Its Token Factory provides access to Sarvam’s models, along with other open-weight models, while the company offers India-based inference and dedicated GPU capacity for its BFSI customers. A bank could use Sarvam’s models, run inference within India, deploy voice agents for customer interactions, use document and workplace agents internally, and build specialised applications around the same infrastructure. The value proposition is not necessarily that Sarvam has the best model for every task, but that it is increasingly able to provide several of those layers under one roof. There is, however, a debate around its India-first positioning. The cofounder and CEO of Smallest.ai, Sudarshan Kamath, argues that Indian-language intelligence alone may not be enough to compete in broader knowledge work, where global models benefit from enormous amounts of English-language data. One practical way to judge that is to look at actual developer usage and whether developers choose Sarvam over alternatives such as Qwen or Gemini.
bangla_paragraph1: SUMMARYSarvam AI has expanded its product portfolio with an upgraded 105B large language model and Dictate, a speech-to-text API supporting English and 22 Indian languages Beyond building sovereign AI models, Sarvam is looking to become a one-stop shop for enterprise AI in India, offering everything from foundation models and inference infrastructure to AI-powered applications While its upgraded 105B model narrows the performance gap with global peers on conversational tasks, its voice AI business is already finding commercial traction, clocking over 3 Mn minutes a day and a billion-plus API calls a month, according to the company Last week, Sarvam AI found itself in the eye of a storm. The poster child of India’s sovereign AI ambitions drew flak for offering access to Chinese AI models, including DeepSeek, Kimi and GLM, through its newly launched inference platform, Token Factory. The point of contention among critics has been whether a startup that received government support to build indigenous AI models should be in the business of selling access to Chinese models. Sarvam clarified that its Token Factory runs on privately procured GPUs, and its inference business does not dilute the ambition to build homegrown AI models. Amid this controversy, the AI unicorn has expanded its product portfolio with two new launches — Sarvam-105B-1711, an upgraded version of its existing large language model (LLM), and Sarvam Dictate, a speech-to-text API that supports English and 22 Indian languages. The launches offer a glimpse into Sarvam’s larger game plan. The unicorn wants to offer Indian enterprises everything they need to build and deploy AI. From homegrown AI models and the infrastructure to run them to voice AI, coding agents and workplace applications, Sarvam desires to become a one-stop shop for enterprise AI in India. Not to mention, Sarvam’s full-stack AI ambition has begun to find commercial traction, particularly in the financial services sector, including Tata Capital and Mahindra Finance. The latter has also deployed Sarvam-powered voice agents across sales, collections and frontline employee engagement. It claims to have executed 1 Cr+ customer calls via its voice stack. At Bolna’s Symphony 2026 last week, Vivek Raghavan, the cofounder of Sarvam AI, claimed that the company was clocking more than 3 Mn minutes a day and had crossed a billion API calls a month for its voice AI business. According to Ankit Jha, a machine learning engineer at Warner Bros. Discovery, post-training allows a company to improve its existing model for particular use cases or edge cases. It is also a common industry practice, with major labs routinely improving existing checkpoints rather than training an entirely new model from scratch. In Sarvam’s case, the original 105B was trained on H100 GPUs, while the post-training runs were carried out on newer Blackwell infrastructure. Jha said Sarvam’s investment in its own technology for training, running and compressing AI models has helped it improve its reinforcement learning capabilities. The results are worth looking at. According to Sarvam, its average score across eight conversational-agent benchmarks has grown from 42.6 to 73.9. Its Indic suite score reached 79.1, while the model also posted 89.

Some of its numbers remain behind larger frontier models on reasoning, coding and knowledge benchmarks. What has changed is the distance between Sarvam and the efficient tier of open models, particularly for workloads where deployment cost, Indian languages and data control matter. Jha said that the model could be a strong option for organisations that want to run AI with less than 100 GB of VRAM. Its roughly 65 GB quantised version can fit into the memory of a high-end workstation-class GPU, opening up a local-AI route that is difficult with much larger models. Kivi and Dictate sit at different points in the same stack. Kivi is the end-user application, while Dictate turns the underlying speech and language capabilities into an API that developers can embed into their products. Sarvam also offers a document-intelligence API, Extract. It pulls structured information from documents so developers can route it into their own products. With Extract, Dictate and Kivi, the company has extended its playbook to include voice and documents. title: What Jensen Huang’s NVIDIA Return Means For India’s AI Players
title_bn: What Jensen Huang’s NVIDIA Return Means For India’s AI Players
author: TechPulse
excerpt: Jensen Huang’s return as NVIDIA CEO has eased concerns over leadership continuity at a key supplier to India’s AI ecosystem.…
paragraph1: SUMMARYHuang’s return brings greater leadership certainty, but is unlikely to immediately improve GPU availability, lower procurement costs for Indian operators Indian AI companies’ dependence on NVIDIA’s hardware and software leaves them exposed to changes in its supply priorities, global demand, and US export policies NVIDIA accounts for 81.6% of compute units listed on the IndiaAI Compute Portal. Analysts recommend diversifying suppliers, improving infrastructure utilisation Jensen Huang’s return as NVIDIA CEO has eased concerns over leadership continuity at a key supplier to India’s AI ecosystem. However, analysts say it does little to address the Indian AI ecosystem’s dependence on the chipmaker or the constraints keeping advanced computing infrastructure expensive. NVIDIA announced Huang’s reinstatement on November 23, following his resignation on November 12. US President Donald Trump welcomed the decision, describing Huang as a “national treasure”. His departure had raised questions about NVIDIA’s investment plans, supply-chain management, pace of product innovation, and ability to retain talent. For Indian companies building AI infrastructure around its chips and software, continuity at NVIDIA offers greater certainty over the supplier’s direction.
paragraph2: “That said, NVIDIA is not a one-person company, but Jensen’s return does bring more certainty, and AI trade is perceiving this to be a good sign. There will be increased controls and governance at the company, which could impact Jensen’s internal influence in the company. This is something to watch for,” Gaurav Gupta, VP analyst at Gartner, told Inc42. The company’s board has said its independent investigation will continue. NVIDIA has also formed a National Security and Export Control Committee and is seeking a chief compliance officer, adding oversight alongside Huang’s return. For Indian buyers, however, leadership certainty does not necessarily translate into easier access to GPUs or lower procurement costs. “The constraints are largely structural, driven by global demand, manufacturing capacity, advanced packaging, high-bandwidth memory availability and US export policies. These cannot be resolved through a leadership decision alone,” said Achyuta Ghosh, India market lead for HFS Research.
paragraph3: Dependence Beyond The Chips NVIDIA’s presence in India spans AI computing infrastructure, software, data centres, startups, developer tools, and strategic partnerships. Greyhound Research’s analysis of the IndiaAI Compute Portal put NVIDIA’s share at 81.6% of 44,077 listed compute units, ahead of Google, AMD, AWS, and Intel. This measures the composition of the cited portal dataset, rather than NVIDIA’s share of India’s total AI computing capacity. A separate estimate by Counterpoint Research puts NVIDIA’s share of India’s high-end AI training and inference capacity at 85-90%. The dependence extends beyond hardware to NVIDIA’s software ecosystem, particularly CUDA, which developers use to build and run GPU-accelerated applications. Indian startups, data centre operators, and large IT services companies are building AI infrastructure and solutions around this combination. While competing chips are available, adopting them requires technical expertise to adapt software and optimise workloads.
paragraph4: This makes diversification more involved than switching hardware suppliers. “Indian operators would be vulnerable if certain decisions are made that cause NVIDIA to prioritise other projects as India might not be the priority,” Gupta added. Smaller Indian data centre providers face a particular challenge because they compete with global hyperscalers with larger purchasing commitments and stronger supply-chain relationships. To reduce this exposure, analysts recommend securing long-term procurement arrangements, exploring alternative accelerators where commercially viable, and developing the flexibility to run workloads across different hardware and cloud platforms. “India’s goal should be to reduce excessive dependence on any single technology architecture while strengthening domestic capabilities in AI infrastructure management, software and optimisation,” Ghosh said. Making Compute Investments Count Beyond supplier diversification, Indian operators face another test – turning expensive infrastructure into commercially useful AI capacity. Analysts expect GPU availability to improve gradually over the next 12-18 months, particularly for older-generation hardware and enterprise inference workloads. However, they do not expect a significant reduction in procurement costs for the latest high-performance GPUs, given continued strong global demand.
paragraph5: This could leave Indian operators paying a premium for the latest systems even as earlier-generation hardware becomes easier to procure. The response, analysts say, must extend beyond adding GPUs to improving utilisation, optimising workloads, reducing power consumption, and managing the cost of inference — the process of running trained AI models. “The greater challenge is ensuring that infrastructure investments translate into enterprise AI adoption, domestic innovation and globally competitive AI capabilities. India’s AI infrastructure success should ultimately be measured by the AI capability and economic value it creates, not simply by the number of GPUs deployed,” Ghosh added. More efficient models and better infrastructure utilisation could allow enterprises to run more AI workloads on the same computing capacity. Consequently, the cost of delivering AI services could decline even if GPU purchase prices remain elevated. For Indian AI ecosystem players, Huang’s return provides greater leadership certainty at their dominant supplier. However, their longer-term economics will depend on how effectively they convert infrastructure investments into AI services that enterprises use and pay for.

title: [Update] Anthropic Rolls Out Claude Duet In India After US Launch
title_bn: [Update] Anthropic Rolls Out Claude Duet In India After US Launch
author: TechPulse
excerpt: Update | November 25, 2026, 18:50 IST Anthropic has expanded the research preview of Claude Duet, its AI-powered work assistant,…
paragraph1: SUMMARYAnthropic has expanded the research preview of Claude Duet, its AI-powered work assistant, to India, a month after its US launch The move brings Anthropic’s proactive AI agent to Indian professionals and businesses, allowing them to automate tasks across connected apps Powered by Claude Opus 5.5, Claude Duet can schedule meetings, track invoices, prepare financial forecasts and build dashboards Access is being offered through a waitlist for US Claude Pro and Max subscribers, with approval required for sending messages, making payments, and other sensitive actions Update | November 25, 2026, 18:50 IST Anthropic has expanded the research preview of Claude Duet, its AI-powered work assistant, to India, a month after its US launch. Built on Anthropic’s Claude Opus 5.5 model, Claude Duet can monitor users’ connected apps, identify tasks needing attention, and work in the background even when users are away from their devices. Its capabilities include scheduling meetings, tracking invoices, preparing financial forecasts, building dashboards, and developing web applications. In India, Pro, Max, and Ultra subscribers can join a waitlist for the research preview. Team users can access the product through a public beta, while enterprise customers will get access through a private beta. Claude Duet is available as a standalone app on iOS and Android, and through Claude’s website. It supports 35 languages, including Hindi, Bengali, Marathi, Tamil, and Telugu. Original | October 22, 2026, 11:36 IST Anthropic has unveiled Claude Duet, a proactive AI agent designed to monitor connected apps, prioritise tasks, and carry out work in the background, including when users switch off their devices.
paragraph2: The offering targets professionals and small business owners. Powered by Claude Opus 5.5, it is available as a research preview through a waitlist for Claude Pro and Max subscribers in the US. Users can access Claude Duet through standalone iOS and Android apps or on Claude’s website. It is included in existing Pro and Max subscriptions but shares usage limits with other Claude products. Background checks count towards these limits, while complex assignments consume more usage, Anthropic said. Unlike conventional AI chatbots, Claude Duet is designed to identify work that needs attention without waiting for a prompt. It sends users a daily briefing covering important items across connected apps, including emails and calendars, and provides updates when tasks are completed or require a decision. Users can assign tasks through text or voice messages, ranging from scheduling meetings and drafting email replies to building dashboards, financial forecasts and web applications. The agent can also search past conversations and use existing Claude memories, skills and connected apps.
paragraph3: Claude Duet connects with more than 6,000 tools and plugins available through the Claude Marketplace, including Gmail, Slack, QuickBooks, Stripe, Gusto, LinkedIn, DocuSign, HubSpot and Shopify. For instance, it can identify unpaid invoices through QuickBooks or Stripe and draft payment reminders. It can also prepare payroll information, draft job postings, create follow-up emails using customer and deal histories, and help businesses set up and manage online stores. The agent runs on its own cloud-based virtual machine with a browser, allowing it to continue working even when users close the app or switch off their devices. Anthropic said it checks connected accounts every few hours rather than continuously, partly to limit subscription usage. Claude Duet can also help users make business purchases through Link, Stripe’s digital wallet, and Shop Pay. Payments require user approval, while Link uses a virtual card to avoid sharing the user’s actual card number. Integration with 1Password for accessing saved website logins is also planned. Anthropic said the agent requires approval before sending messages, making payments, signing documents or deleting information. Trading securities and transferring money between accounts remain prohibited, even with user approval.
paragraph4: Users can disconnect apps, and only they can mark tasks as finished. Safeguards And Early Limitations Anthropic said Claude Duet includes safeguards designed to prevent unauthorised actions, prompt injection, and sensitive data leaks. Prompt injection involves malicious instructions hidden in content an agent encounters, such as emails or websites. The protections include an automated system that assesses proposed actions and controls designed to keep passwords and sign-in tokens out of the agent’s direct view. A separate message-checking system is designed to block requests to share highly sensitive information, including credit card numbers and government identification. Other sensitive information, such as health and personal finance details, can be shared only on explicit user instructions, Anthropic said. The company said Claude Duet has undergone adversarial testing and external penetration testing, and is covered by its public bug bounty programme. However, Anthropic acknowledged that the early version may misinterpret conversations, misjudge urgency, or miss information arriving between checks. It is currently better suited to work assignments than personal errands, such as booking tickets, and users cannot yet view its browser. The launch adds to the growing competition in always-on AI agents that work across apps with limited human intervention.
paragraph5: OpenAI’s Dots and Meta’s Muse target similar use cases, while Bengaluru-based Emergent’s Wingman handles tasks across email, calendars, and workplace software through WhatsApp and Telegram. As agents gain access to more business systems, their permissions and accountability are also coming under scrutiny. Recently, CERT-In warned about unauthorised AI agent access to Indian organisations’ systems, highlighting the risks associated with deploying increasingly autonomous tools. Anthropic said feedback from early users will inform further development. The research preview does not currently include Team and Enterprise subscribers. A message from : Mobavenue AI Tech Limited is an AI-Powered AdTech and Consumer Growth platform helping brands reach high-intent audiences through data-driven, scalable, and transparent marketing solutions.
